The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach and also show the great importance of PSF estimation in video super-resolution reconstruction. This error-parameter analysis method may also be well extensively used to estimate other types of PSF, only if the PSF can be denoted by parameters.

articleTitle: Observer-based robust stabilization for uncertain linear systems with state and input delays
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Observer-based robust stabilization for uncertain linear systems with state and input delays is studied. A sufficient condition is given for the existence of the state observer and the observer-based robust controller for such uncertain system is also designed. The detail design procedures are presented by solving linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). At last, an illustrative numerical example is presented, which shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on emergency supplies demand forecasting model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In the analysis of emergency supplies on the basis of demand characteristics, through the nearest neighbor method and combination of case-based reasoning, fuzzy reasoning and case-based reasoning combines two kinds of emergency supplies for the establishment of demand forecasting model and forecasting methods used in conjunction with empirical analysis, an example is, pointing out that the feasibility of forecasting methods, emergency supplies for emergency needs by providing fast and feasible prediction methods.

articleTitle: The design of ECG signals dually filtering based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The paper introduces that an approach of Electrocardiograph(ECG) FIR filtering based on FPGA, combined with DSP Builder and Quartus II for hardware and software simulation, gains the best ECG FIR filter. FPGA is used to dually filter the collected ECG signals which includes the 50Hz interference and high-frequency interference, which further enhance the filtering effect. The design can effectively filter out noisy signal, to overcome the shortcomings of analog circuit filter, thus reducing the complexity of analog circuits to improve FPGA-based ECG monitoring system performance, contribute to the judgment of the ECG's diagnostic accuracy, and has a well practical value.

articleTitle: The design and realization of Young's Modulus of Metal Materials Measurement system based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With Virtual Instrument technology, the authors designed Young's Modulus of Metal Materials measurement system which has realized the computer measurement of the Young's Modulus by using of computers and data acquisition card and LabVIEW software and combining with the measuring instrument of Young's Modulus scanning frequency method. The Young's modulus of metal materials measurement system based on Virtual Instrument use the scanning frequency method to measure, compared with the traditional method of stretching and dynamic suspension, not only measuring speed is faster and more accurate, processing data is more convenient, operating performance is more stable, but also realized the measurement's digitization and computerization, and the system has laid a good foundation for processing the data further.

articleTitle: QCA circuit design based on novel optimal ULG.2
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Quantum-dot cellular automata (QCA) is a promising nanotechnology, with the potential for faster speed, smaller size and lower power consumption than CMOS technology. In QCA circuit design, However, wire-crossing is an issue. Universal logic gates (ULG) have stronger function than traditional logic gates. This paper begins with a review of QCA. Then a novel QCA optimal ULG.2 is obtained using a new algorithm and modular design methodology. Some circuits are implemented with the ULG.2. As an example, finally, a full adder/subtraction is constructed by applying the ULG.2. The simulation results confirm that all the proposed circuits not only hold correct logic function but also achieve a considerable wire-crossing count reduction in comparison to the other previous designs.

articleTitle: Dynamics analyze of a dual-arm space robot system based on Kane's method
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Dynamics is the bridge between design and control, as space robots gain more and more importance in space operations, it was becoming imperative to understand their distinctive dynamics and control characteristics. In the absence of fixed base, the dynamic equation of system no longer be linearly parameterized, and the dynamics of space robotic systems could be quite complex and their control could be difficult. The dynamics of a dual-arm space robot system was systematically studied, and a dynamic model based on Kane-Huston's method and screw theory was presented in this paper. The numerical example shows that acting moment of a composition unit of the robot can be solved for given value of motion parameters with the exploitation of the dynamic model, vice versa. Furthermore, the planning technique for position/force control approach can be explored by designing the motion law for composition unit. Simulations results of the proposed dynamic model, which based on Kane-Huston's method and screw theory of the dual-arm space robot system, are very useful.

articleTitle: An intelligent nondestructive detection method based on wavelet processing and principal component analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To improve the performance of the acoustic nondestructive detection, an intelligent method was put forward. By using the wavelet transform (WT) with the optimal basis, the original acoustic resonance spectroscopy (ARS) signal was projected to the wavelet subspace at first, and then the signal was represented by a matrix of wavelet coefficients. To reduce the amount of calculation, the principal component analysis (PCA) was performed: The feature vector was obtained by Karhunen-Loeve transformation (K-L transformation), serving as the input of the neural network. Finally, a radial basis function (RBF) neural network was developed as a classifier using the recursive localized least square method. Simulation and experimental results showed that the proposed method is accurate and have good generalization ability.

articleTitle: Research of static var compensator control system based on DSP technology
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: We present the principle of the Static Var Compensator, and introduce the design of a static var compensator control system. The design techniques of DSP CPU board and signal conditioning circuit is analyzed in this paper. We describe the fast algorithm solving reactive power and PID algorithm with variable parameter avoiding integral saturation in detail. The performance of static var compensator control system is also evaluated through wave measurement.

articleTitle: A new method of speaker localization using the filtered correlation
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Speaker localization is defined as the determination of the coordinates of the speaker in relation to a point in space. It is achieved by using a comparison between the signals received by different microphones to estimate the position and eventually the identity of the speaker. In the present paper, we have conducted a multidisciplinary research project, which led us to several interesting results. For that purpose, we used the information given by two cardioids microphones, placed in opposition: one at the left and the other at the right of the speakers, in order to determine the position of the active speaker and try to supervise the audio-visual recording (eg. supervision of meeting-rooms). To achieve the speaker localization task, we have employed a new detection method, which we called: the filtered correlation method. The principle of this method is based on the calculation of the correlation between the two signals collected by the two microphones and a special filtering, which preserve only the pitch bandwidth. Experiments are done on several scenarios containing one, two or three speakers in the meeting-room. Results show an efficiency of the proposed localization method and a possible tracking by camera.

articleTitle: 3-D calibration method for freehand ultrasound image with high precision based on string-beads phantom
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: As extremely important techniques of MRCAS, Z-string-beads phantom and optimization algorithm for manual imaging coordinates are investigated to improve the precisions of 3-D ultrasound (US) calibration which defines the spatial relationship between the US image plane and an external tracking device attached to the US probe. The phantom consists of accurate position beads and two layers of Z-string planar arrays. The beads can rapidly guide the user to align the probe accurately for imaging, so their coordinates are directly used in the algorithm for homologous points matching without any transformations; the optimized algorithm incorporates the imaging points coordinates (mass centre coordinates of each point) in multiple US images that corrects the manual marking coordinates of the imaging points. The calibration parameters are calculated by matching of homologous points in the image and the tracking device and the 2-D US image can be converted into 3-D US coordinates. The results show that this method can simplify the calibration algorithm, reduce the influences of the US beam thickness on the precision and improve the calibration precision and reconstruction accuracy of the 3-D US system. The calibration experiments are demonstrated with a magnetic locator, but the method could be suitable for other tracking devices.

Author Keywords: medical robotics and computer assisted surgery(MRCAS)

articleTitle: The system of ultrasonic testing scanner for pressure vessel
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The in-service inspection is necessary for pressure vessel. The hard environment requires the device holding some of necessary characters, such as simple structure, convenient mounting, enough stability and light mass etc. The automatic ultrasonic testing device was equipped permanent magnet which performed the adsorption and circular motion of the scanner in cylinder's working surface. According to the actual requirement of work environment, this system employed ultrasonic board and notebook computer to realize data acquisition. The random position was got through magnetic wheel which adsorp force and keep the stabilization. On the basis advantages of modular design method, the main body of the scanner was introduced in detail. The scanner mounted on the main body and the appropriate arm can achive the trace of ultrasonic wave detector. The dissertation studied the static stability of the scanner for pressure vessel loop welds.

articleTitle: Reverse supply Chain's incentive analysis under government supervision
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper studies the incentive mechanism of RSC in government regulation. On the condition of subsidies and punishment being an independent parameters, the government may choose three incentive programs: first is the program of subsidies and punishment simultaneous implementation, second is the program of only punishment, third is the program of only subsidies. We can educe that from the comparison of three different programs, the first program is the optimal incentive program. The results have important theoretical and practical significance to government making-decision of environmental policy. And the results laid the theoretical foundation to further study government and enterprise contracts.

articleTitle: Fermentation temperature control opitimisation in laboratory scale using MAX-MIN ant system and multi-point temperature instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Beer fermentation is a complex, non-linear process, to reduce the fermentation time while preserving fermentation quality parameters, following certain temperature control curve gains desired results. Dynamic optimization process of the beer batch fermentation is described. A temperature optimization profile is searched through ant colony system which is based on MAX-MIN ant system. A multi-point temperature inspect instrument was designed to obtain more temperature information in tank. The laboratory-scale fermentation set-up was built. The sensor helps to improve control precision. A smooth temperature profile was able to be obtained based on this optimization method, and it is easy to be presented as few linear segments.

articleTitle: Low-FOM planar MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Low FOM (Figure-of-merit) planar MOSFET is presented in this paper. The p-base of the developed MOSFET is formed by self-aligned ion implanted. Only four masks is used to fabrication while the performance of the developed MOSFET is better than the present conventional MOSFET. The optimized 20V rated MOSFET exhibits about 7.8mΩ·mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> specific on-resistance, 1.2nC·mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 3.4 nC·mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> gate-drain charge and gate charge respectively. There is a reduction of 57% in the Figure of Merit.

articleTitle: The implement of the stored-grain grossness remote monitoring system based on GPRS and ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: According to the actual demand of the system, the paper proposed scheme and implement for the stored-grain grossness remote monitoring system based on GPRS and Zigbee. The test result is shown that the max error is ∼0.02mA between inversion value of the server-side data and the measure value. The design should be served as the useful reference to the study of acquisition technology in similar system.

articleTitle: Design of data acquisition system based on PCI-1710
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A data acquisition system based on Advantech PCI-1710 is designed. PCI-1710 is used as the hardware platform of the system. The program is developed with Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0 by dint of Advantech 32 bit DLL drivers, drive and control of PCI-1710, which makes data acquisition, data transfer and data storage. The system has good commonality as well as extensibility and can be widely used in many dada acquisition areas.

articleTitle: Guidance based autonomous parking assistant
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper presents a novel and computationally inexpensive method for motion planning of autonomous diagonal or row parking of four wheeled nonholonomic vehicles. The proposed method makes use of Trajectory Shaping Guidance, given in [1] and [2], which was originally developed for missiles to hit the target at a given angle. This paper uses a modified version of Trajectory Shaping Guidance (TSG) for path planning. The method computes a feasible path by inherently considering nonholonomic constraints of the vehicle. Detailed simulation results show the robustness, simplicity and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A new authenticated encryption schemes without using Hash and Redundancy functions
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A new type of authenticated encryption schemes combined signature with message recovery schemes and symmetric encryption schemes together. It was an authenticated encryption without using Hash functions or Redundancy functions. However, we found the scheme does not have a digital signature of the basic conditions required, and can not resist the forgery attack of the news recipient, At the same time, we proposed a new authenticated encryption schemes, the security of new scheme is based on solving the discrete logarithm problem and the dual-mode problem, and whenever a dispute arises, the authenticated encryption signature will be converted into an ordinary signature, anyone can verify the validity of signatures.

articleTitle: Multi-dynamic displacement measurement based on digital image processing technology
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The multi-point dynamic-displacement data of structure is an important parameter for structural health monitoring. The difficulties of traditional multi-dynamic displacement measurement are reference point selecting and massive data processing. A novel multi-dynamic displacement measurement system was developed based on digital image processing technology. The calibration method based on surface fitting and window-centroid tracking algorithm was applied to determine the relationship between the object space and pixel coordinate system. The displacement data was acquired by comparing the change of the centroid pixel. The expectations based on wavelet coefficients were used for sub-pixel edge detection, measurement accuracy can reach 0.02 pixels. The dynamic displacement of four-layer steel frame structure was monitored on the shaking table. The results show that the system can achieve the monitoring of multi-channel 2-D dynamic displacements, the accuracy of displacement survey can reach 0.1mm.

articleTitle: A parallel Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithm can be applied to problems in Economies, Management and Engineering; actually, most of design problem in real world can be reduced to multi-objective optimization problem. This paper proposed a new Parallel Evolutionary Algorithm based multi-objective optimal algorithm. The experimental results show that this algorithm can obtain quite fine approximated Pareto fronts and the fronts cover the theoretical Pareto front; these results imply that the proposed algorithm performs well.

articleTitle: Car fault diagnosis system based on FNN and rule-based inference
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: there fault diagnosis methods, i.e. fuzzy inference, rule-based inference and the combination of both, are analyzed and their shortcomings in studying the relation between symptoms and causes of mechanical fault are also pointed out in this paper. Based on these, an advanced method is educed, in which the fuzzy neural network (FNN) instead of fuzzy inference is used and combined with rule-based inference. The result of a sample diagnosis on a real car shows that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Application research of data warehouse technology in decision-making of drug distribution enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A decision support system based on data warehouse technology for a pharmaceutical distribution company was designed and implemented. The system can provide effective decision support for managers of the company. The development approach of this system have a high reference value for design and development of application systems that based on Oracle data warehouse.

articleTitle: A practical method for detecting the status of grounding grids
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Precise measurement of corrosion status of grounding grid and grounding resistance is a fundamental factor in the protection of power systems. For this purpose, this paper presents a new method, in which, quasi-steady-state measurement is used to detect the conductors' corrosion state and a relation data base between the corrosion depth and grounding resistance is built to obtain the corresponding value of grounding resistance. The results obtained using the method proposed are compared with results measured by fall-of-potential method. Our work has shown that this method can provide a fast-resolution industrial application with acceptable results.

articleTitle: Status monitoring and performance evaluation based on the operating condition of hydroelectric generating unit
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The operating status of equipment are closely related to the operation conditions of hydroelectric generating unit. A critical issue of maintenance automation system is how to make performance evaluation and states analysis at the same operation conditions about the hydroelectric generating equipment. A condition monitoring and performance evaluation method based on operating conditions of hydroelectric generating unit is brought out in this paper. The condition criterions and operating condition synchronization method of online monitoring system are expounded in detail. Finally, it is introduced that the condition-based fault diagnosis process and its application with a real example.

articleTitle: The machine recognition of Chinese ancient copper coin
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Chinese ancient copper coins have a square hole inside a circle shape. To recognize Chinese ancient copper coins from a bunch of other stuff, the program needs to recognize the circle shape and the square shape individually. We present a method which can be used to recognize Chinese ancient copper coins efficiently in this article. This method has two steps. Firstly, identify the circle by using the roundness judgment formula. Secondly, identify the square by using the Hough transform. This method is very efficient and can be used in the customs export examination as a common procedure.

articleTitle: Embedded quality control system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation

authors.preferredName: Kamesh Gokul Raj Dharmarajan Selva Bai
authors.lastName: Kamesh Gokul Raj Dharmarajan Selva Bai

abstract: In the present world where quality control has become a most needed and costlier venture, the need for reducing the cost of quality testing of mechanical parts has gained importance so that it can be implemented effectively in all kind of industries. Normally the production happens using molding machinery with some malfunctions which changes the size of the products, present quality system is semi automated and need human help to identify the defect and uses costly testing equipments such as LASER resulting in a cost of Lakhs. Here we have developed a fully automated system named as EQCS that is capable of identifying the defects of the spare parts at micron scale; it also reduces the fluctuation of auto parts quality, and improves Robustness and performance. The system is designed for weight calculation, and also for Temperature and pressure sustainability testing which confirms the quality of the product that is being tested. The system is also featured with a perfect mechanical design which adapts to any industrial environment. This paper outlines the approach to build an intelligent system that is capable of testing the quality of the auto parts and interacting with the remote server to avoid the defects being produced by the machinery any further. Our main objective was to bring up a low cost solution and with this system we can maintain the quality to the maximum level at minimal cost ranging for auto parts such as screws, frames, engine components and various other parts.

Author Keywords: Sustainability - Ability to sustain to the maximum

articleTitle: Intelligent public transportation system based on AT91SAM9G20
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This article according to the current tendency of Chinese municipal transportation development, proposes the more reasonable solution about embedded platform. Connecting the MCU and the GPRS module through the serial ports, then transmits the AT instruction to the serial port. It causes the platform to be able to relation to the office terminal through the 3G network. Achieved that various sensors collected information in the vehicle can transmit mutually effect with the tube control center.

articleTitle: Mobile computing framework based on MAP in IPv6 network
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: As the mobile Internet support the mobile IP and mobile multicast in the one network architecture, while the two data streams simultaneously deliver on the foreign network when mobile nodes is roamed, it is very necessary to establish a scheme to properly handle these forwarding data for eliminating the potential confliction of consumption of the network resource, such as bandwidth, queue buffers, etc. In this paper, we construct a mobile computing framework based on MAP which both supports the mobile unicast and multicast transmission. Our works extend the functionality of the MAP entity and apply the optimum algorithm to distribute the data flows, and to achieve one effective, balance, scalable, all-around mobile computing framework.

articleTitle: Development of math model and vibrating simulation of the high-speed spindle
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The spindle is an important component of two-for-one twisting machine. It gives the yarn twisting through high speed revolving. To solve the problems of resonance and noises, it is necessary to calculate frequency and analysis for spindle. With the establishment of math model, vibrating simulation is applied to natural frequency and vibration mode. It avoids the frequency of exciting force and natural frequency to be same or close. The finite element method studies the structure statics, the dynamics question effective method. It has some steps such as solid model establishment, restraint and load steps increasing, and modal analysis and so on. This method can accurately obtain the result high speed and become the structure mechanical analysis the powerful tool.

articleTitle: Research on the design of swing pilot platform for aerial photographic UAV
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This thesis first analyses the causes for producing swing angle, and then proposes to reduce this angle by using swing pilot platform. The mechanical structure of the platform is introduced, and a new Magnetic Heading Measurement System based on the magnetoresistive sensor and the MEMS accelerometer is designed. According to the features of main components, the error compensation algorithm is used to make sure the accuracy of direction angle. The test results indicate that the swing pilot platform can keep the direction angle stable even under crosswinds condition. The accuracy of aerial photographic swing angle is within three degrees.

articleTitle: The reform and practice for mathematics series curricula based on four-dimensional teaching model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to train the high-quality talented students, the educating theory is updated and the teaching model is reformed. The excellent basic mathematics teaching group is formed. The four dimensional teaching model, which is formed from four parts — learning math, use math, do math research, and competing math, is implemented in Maoyisheng and experimental classes. The goals which are four combinations, the base and development, the tradition and modern, the theory and practice and the routine and excellence are got. The multimedia teaching method can strengthen the math base of the students; the math experiments can help the students master the computing skills; the lectures can exercise the students' application abilities; and the modeling training can train the creativity of the students.

articleTitle: A rolling legged robot with elliptical cylinder body
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper presents a new idea to design a robot with an elliptical cylinder as the main body. And four legs are also used as the supports. This kind of robot has two or three modes of motion and the modes convert between each other during the process of movement. In the stage of conversion, the driving motors are inputted in a torque to make the main body roll. When the robot roll over across barriers, there has the energy transformation between Potential and Kinetic. By this way, it can reduce energy consumption. Because of the energy transformation between Potential and Kinetic, the robot can roll free after the disappearance of torque. The process of the movement is researched, especially the transformation between the two modes of movement. And the conversion stage can be summarized as four steps. The analyses have done to explain the four steps and the movement consquence for the robot legs, both the thigh and the shank, have given out. And the torque change condition during the conversion has figured out.

articleTitle: Improved Bayesian network in steam turbine fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The fault diagnosis model of steam turbine based on Bayesian network is direct impacts on the complexity of the diagnostic process, so the construction of Bayesian network model is the primary problem. According actual fault diagnosis system of steam turbine containing redundancy and uncertain information, proposed attribute reduction method to fault feature, obtained the minimal diagnosis rules. Based on two-node union reverse inference, proposed an improved program in the construction of Bayesian network. The Bayesian network model based on the minimum fault decision table can effectively reduce the complexity of the network structure, while the using of improved Bayesian network can further reduce complexity of structure and improve the diagnosis speed. Finally, the effectiveness and fastness of this method are validated by the result of practical fault diagnosis example in Bently-RK4 rotor vibration bench.

articleTitle: Teaching of mathematics education under the new curriculum standard
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The implementation of new course standard of mathematics is one of the significant changes of our educational business. Through our analysis of the present mathematics education to discuss the new idea of mathematics education under the new curriculum standard, the new ways of mathematics classroom teaching under the new curriculum standard are given in the paper.

articleTitle: The research of the cooperative OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The main idea to the OFDM is to divide the channel into many orthogonal sub channels in the frequency, which use parallel transmission sub-carriers to modulate. So that, the signal bandwidth is less than the channel coherence bandwidth, which can effectively eliminate ISI. Cooperative diversity is widely used in wireless communication. By taking the advantage of cooperative communication, we try to combine Cooperative diversity with OFDM. In this paper, key technologies of OFDM system, two types of cooperative protocols to realize cooperative diversity in OFDM systems, and two kinds of combining methods, are proposed. Simulations on two types of cooperative protocols to realize cooperative diversity, on two kinds of combining methods are performed. In addition, we simulated the performance of the cooperative diversity OFDM system with relay nodes located in different locations.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of duct conveying using smoothed particles hydrodynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: An efficient smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) method for duct conveying is proposed. We have implemented a 2D SPH code for duct conveying, which extends industrial application field of SPH method. The simulation results of 2D SPH accord with the experimental results. Numerical simulation results show that major physics of the duct conveying can be well captured in the simulation. The SPH method proposed can be easily extended to deal with many other problems of duct flow if simulation control parameters such as input condition, boundary condition and corresponding equation of state etc. are defined properly.

articleTitle: Thermal characteristic simulation of semiconductor laser based on Abaqus
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The finite element software ABAQUS used for thermal properties simulation of SQW semiconductor lasers is described. And ABAQUS is applied for simulation of transient thermal distribution of 808nm SQW semiconductor lasers driven by pulses. The results show that the thermal analysis using ABAQUS software is very convenient and fast.

articleTitle: The design of shuttle embroidery machine controller based On μC/OS-II
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With regard to traditional mechanical shuttle embroidery machine, the embedded network module ETR100 is used for realizing the design of shuttle embroidery controller based on μC/OS-II in this paper. The electronic lag driven by electromagnet is used for replacing traditional perforation tapes. Pattern can be displayed on the liquid crystal screen. At the same time the U-shaped disk is used for depositing styling documents and data is read out by the controller and directly controls embroidery machines. The system is outstanding with short implemental period and low costs. It has better reliability, rich function and friendly human-computer interaction. Furthermore it'll improve labor productivity and reduce labor intensity of workers.

articleTitle: A novel DOA estimation technique for coherent real-valued sources
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper proposes a new DOA estimation technique for coherent real-valued signal sources which is named Modified Covariance AR spectrum estimation of Modified Cross Correlation Sequence (MCCS-MC) algorithm. Firstly, we introduce the basic principle of the new technique: transform the DOA of the sources into frequency of a modified sequence, and get the arrival angles by power spectrum estimation of the sequence. Then we focus on the performance analysis of the proposed technique. Simulation results show that the algorithm not only solves the angle ambiguity problem in the DOA estimation of real-valued signals, but also precisely and stably estimates the arrival angles of coherent sine signals without spatial smoothing or matrix rebuilding.

articleTitle: Video dynamic interpolation based on weighted shift interframe motion model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A dynamic filtering algorithm for video sequence interpolation, which based on weighted shift interframe motion model, is proposed in this article. This paper reviews classical monoframe interpolation and multiframe interpolation. We also analyze the characteristic of the motion model in the video sequence. And after that, the motion model is modified to reduce the computation and system complexity. In the end of the paper, we make use of Kalman filtering algorithm to interpolate the image dynamically to gain high resolution. Experimental results show the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Modulation transfer function in seeker camera limits resulting from missile flutter caused by aerodynamic force
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The imaging quality of seeker in flight mode has been evaluated through analyzing the effects of missile flutter on optical modulation transfer function (MTF) of the optical system. Firstly the data of transverse vibration has been processed to eliminate the trend term caused by the trajectory, then obtained the displacement with two times trapezoidal integration. For the side rotation, the high frequency noise interference in the data has been filtered by using five-point moving average method. Took this model as the quivering rule between the object and the image, and then analyzed the effects of the transverse vibration and the side rotation on imaging quality through MTF. By calculation, the r.m.s value of the image motion caused by missile transverse vibration is 0.026mm, and the side rotation angle is 0.0044°. Through the establishment of two modulation transfer functions (MTF) of image random vibration and linear vibration, the results show that the image quality had declined, and the effect of transverse vibration on image quality is obvious. Through improving the rigidity of the missile and selection of small focal length optical system and shorten the time of exposure can improve the imaging quality of the seeker.

articleTitle: Recognition of fire levels using fuzzy reasoning
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Today, various types of sensors such as CCTV, temperature detector, CO2 detector, are widely used to prevent fire occurrence in public places. They are integrated into an intelligent surveillance system to monitor indication of fire and to alarm various levels of warning automatically. A fuzzy system is proper to solve the problem considering an ambiguous property of fire signs from various sensors. In this paper, we proposed a fuzzy rule-based method for the recognition of fire levels. We evaluated the performance with a prototype application.

articleTitle: The analysis and design of grain logistics information platform based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With regard to the distribution of the grain logistics, to analyze the structure and the function of the grain logistics information platform based on GIS. To provide an ideal solution according to the problem of the distribution of the grain logistics, the core modules were studied in this paper, such as the transportation vehicles and goods real-time monitoring and the vehicle's route planning in the progress of the grain distribution. Then, the grain logistics information platform is successful constructed by GIS technique. It can play an important role in the daily operation and management of the grain logistics enterprise, which will improve the companies' efficiency of the grain delivery operation, and reduce the cost of the grain logistics.

articleTitle: On the monotonicity property of the Monge-Ampere type operator of convex functions on the anisotropic Heisenberg group
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: We prove the monotonicity property of the Monge-Ampere type operator for a class of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">σ</sup>2-convex functions on the anisotropic Heisenberg group via using integration by parts based upon the structure of the group.

articleTitle: Cutting data decision system based on knowledge classification and basic data model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The causes that limit the widespread use of cutting database are done with in the paper. A new cutting knowledge classification method is applied to settle the complex and changeable expression of cutting operation objects. The basic data model is put forward to share public data with other system based on the cutting data sharing platform. The platform is built that provide model tools to support the model define and system architecture. The prototype system was developed and used in several manufacture enterprise.

articleTitle: Statistical characteristics of tropopause influenced by stratosphere over Wuhan and Haikou
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The temporal variation characteristics of local tropopause are derived from the routine radiosonde data obtained at Wuhan( 30.5° N, 114° E)and Haikou (20°N, 114°E) from 2000 to 2004. By discussing the temperature disturbance and lapse rate at certain pressure levels and tropospheric thickness, it's concluded that tropopause was more determined by the stratospheric behavior and compared with the results from other site. An intensive radiosonde observation over Wuhan from Jan 11 to 15, in 2006, was conducted with a 3 hours interval, which also offered evidence of the affection of stratosphere on troposphere.

articleTitle: An effective algorithm of tracking multiple objects in occlusion scenes
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In the field of Computer Vision (CV), multiple object tracking has been one of the hot issues, and it is especially one of difficulties to effectively track multiple objects in occlusion scenes. In this paper, we propose an effective algorithm to dissolve the occlusion issue in tracking multiple objects, combining the feature of overlap region with the feature of RGB-based dominant color histogram (DCH). Firstly, occlusion can be judged by computing the size of overlap region. Secondly, if occlusion takes place, RGB-based DCH can be used to estimate the likelihood of occluded objects. And then, the occluded objects are tracked effectively. Additionally, RGB-based DCH is only computed when merging and splitting, and the computational complexity is effectively reduced. From the experimental results, the proposed algorithm can improve the validity and robustness of tracking multiple objects.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of listed companies on incentive stock option
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Principal-agent problems are the difficult issues which cannot be solved in the process of operating. To solve the issue with incentive stock option has a solid theoretical foundation. Monitoring and incentives are essential to incentive stock options. Because the utility function of the agent can not be observed directly, the effect must be decided by the empirical analysis in order to judge the effect of incentive stock options. According to the SPSS analysis of state-owned listed companies, it can be known that the effect of incentive stock options of state-owned listed companies is not good, indicating that the supervisory mechanism of the company is imperfect.

articleTitle: Model identification and closed-loop Confirmation for opto-electronic platform of seeker
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A mathematical model of seeker opto-electronic platform is the basis for researching performance, designing a servo control system and simulating. Focusing on high frequencies of mechanical resonant, restriction of gimbaled axis rotation, a new model identification method was proposed under the pseudo-random invert-M-sequences. The testing signal, data acquisition, the calculating of frequency response, and least square identification were investigated. The realized steps are explicitly illustrated, and the testing example is given in this paper, the results confirm that the proposed method is effective and practical.

articleTitle: The soliton control research based parameters for a nonlinear system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The exact soliton solutions are constructed by extending the (G'/G)-expansion method for a nonlinear system. The soliton controls are investigated. The soliton shapes can be under the controls of the parameters in the soliton solutions.

articleTitle: Learning to reach object with the desired pose by using visual information
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: We focus on the object reaching problem for eye-on-hand robot system: how to control the end-effector to reach the exact position and orientation according to the visual information of object. The exact position and orientation are defined as “reaching pose” in this paper. Two issues are mainly concerned and this leads to two contributions in this paper: (1) Find the relationship between reaching pose and object pose in the image. Unlike traditional methods based on complex calibration, supervised learning algorithm is introduced to learn the relationship based on training data which are collected automatically. This method has two main advantages: 1) it can be implemented with little human assistance and 2) it can handle non-linear case. (2) Represent the object pose in the image. A novel and robust algorithm is proposed to extract the feature points. The feature points are robust and invariant under translation, rotation and scaling. Then those feature points are sorted into a sequence which corresponds to the input-variable vector. The sequence is also robust to make sure the consistency of the meanings of the input variables. Finally, the experiments show the validity of our method.

articleTitle: Automatic test equipment to enhance laser production line capacity utilization
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The two most important indicators of the factory are the quality and production efficiency. The key factors of quality test are the repeatability and reproducibility. But the artificial test inevitably brings about the error and low efficiency. Use of automatic test equipment significantly improves the reliability and efficiency of the test.

articleTitle: A VS-IMM algorithm for maneuvering target tracking
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Tracking of highly maneuvering targets with unknown behavior is a difficult problem in state estimation. This paper presents an adaptive interacting multiple model algorithm (IMM) utilizing adaptive turn rate models to track a maneuvering target. The turn rate is calculated at each step form the estimator of velocity and the radius of curvature of the trajectory of the target by using Least Square (LS) and curve fitting theory. Simulation in different scenario proves that the turn-rate estimation techniques in this adaptive framework can significantly solve the problem of tracking maneuvering targets.

articleTitle: An Application of the Finite Difference Method and Control Variate Technique in the American Options Pricing
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Option pricing theory is one of important achievements of modern finance theory, it embodies core problem of finance theory. The main methods of option pricing at present are traditional method, B-S Option Pricing Model, Finite Difference Method, Binary Tree methods, where the latter two methods are numerical methods of discrete form. The paper aiming at option pricing problem, utilize Finite Difference Method and Control Variant Technique to obtain the more accurate solution of American Option.

articleTitle: Analysis of the qualities and abilities normal university students majoring in mathematics should posses under “New Curriculum Standard”
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The implementation of “New Curriculum standard” requires that normal universities students majoring in mathematics should possess the following qualities: the ideological and moral quality, cultural quality, business quality, physical and mental quality, as well as the following abilities: the awareness and ability of mathematics application, the awareness of social advocacy, flexible use of various of teaching methods, strong education management and organizational skills, strong language skills and aesthetic capabilities, skilled use of foreign languages and computers, strong spirit of innovation, awareness of mathematics education and scientific research. In this paper we discuss the qualities and abilities students majoring in mathematics should posses under “New Curriculum Standard”.

articleTitle: Numerical approach to parameter identifiability of mechanical system nonlinear parametric models
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Model parameters are identifiable if there exists a unique relationship between its input-output behaviour and the parameter values. Identifiability of parameters is one of the most important steps in parameter identification of mechanical system nonlinear dynamic models. The concept and a numerical approach of analyzing the identifiability of model parameters are presented in this paper. It is proposed via case study that one had better check the local identifiability of the model at the identified parameter point using the numerical approach, when the parameter identification procedure has been finished.

articleTitle: Image restoration using a new regularized particle filter
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, a new regularized particle filter is proposed and applied in mixed noisy image restoration. The general particle filter sample from discrete approximation distribution to cause inaccurate sample for not considering measurement information. In order to reducing the sample error, the regularized continuous distribution sample which is achieved by kernel density approximation function for posterior distribution is proposed when resampling. Meanwhile combing cumulative distribution function (CDF) which can be realized easily and minimize the variance in this new regularized resampling step, thus the degradation problem can be alleviated well. The experiments show the effectiveness of the algorithm, and demonstrated the superiority when comparing with wavelet threshold shrink methods and sample importance resampling (SIR) particle filter method.

articleTitle: Semantic reasoning based on rough logic on n-dimensional approximate space
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The universe is extended from subsets of U to subsets of U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> in Pawlak rough logic theory. The subsequent discussions could be conducted on n-dimensional approximation space, which denote as M = (U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>, R). The formal language in rough logic and the n-ary formulas have been put forward in this paper. According to discussing n-ary formulas in n-dimensional space based on the five rough logical values in Pawlak rough logic, some especial properties of n-ary formulas are gained. With the way of semantic reasoning, some forms of logical reasoning in classical logic have been studied. And we get some theorems which indicate that some forms of logical reasoning are also true in rough logic for five rough logical values.

articleTitle: Research of dynamic routing based on improved Dynamic Ant Colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The reliability and distance of Power Line Communication (PLC) are the most important factors, which limit the application of PLC in practice seriously. This paper discusses the specialties and the methods of building up the PLC networks, uses an improved Dynamic Ant Colony System algorithm (DACS) in dynamic routing of PLC networks, and the multi-path storage technology is given. The improved DACS enhanced the accuracy and efficiency of dynamic routing in two aspects, that is the best tours and the worst tours. A dynamic penalty on worst tours will open up chances for ants to navigate, limit intentions and provide cautions in an ant's decision to move. And ants can get better search guidance by concentrating only the best tours from all groups. The simulation and experimentation indicate that the improved DACS provides an effective dynamic routing method for the expansion of PLC. It is an effective method of improving the reliability of PLC.

articleTitle: Intelligent control model for Checking data quality in hospital process management
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Hospital process management ought to deliver better value in terms of end-to-end services. Making managerial decisions based on electronic data generated by the Hospital Information System (HIS) to be more easily manipulated and destroyed than paper document. It is therefore important for auditors to assure that the information in HIS is well-controlled and high quality. This research aims to develop a control model, namely the Information Gap Checking Mechanism (IGAP Checking Mechanism), to automatically check the information gap between computerized process flows and workflow. This study also justifies the feasibility of IGAP-Checking Mechanism by providing a real case study. The result indicates that the IGAP-Checking Mechanism can assist the case hospital in resolving information quality problems that have occurred in its HIS and can also provide value service for the hospital.

articleTitle: The study on the influence of IT capabilities to the Sustainable Competitive Advantage
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: It is a reliable guarantee for enterprises to establish sustainable competitive advantage as the enterprises want to remain invincible in the market. As an important source of modern enterprises obtaining sustainable competitive advantage, IT capabilities play a more and more important role. Based on the dynamic capabilities and from the composition of IT capabilities, this paper analyzes the influence of IT capabilities to the Sustainable Competitive Advantage, and puts forward an influence model of IT capabilities to the Sustainable Competitive Advantage.

articleTitle: A kind of method for fabric image mosaic
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Based on the fabric image mosaics problem is researched. In the aspect of image edge extraction using cellular automaton model, carries on the research on the characteristics of fabric image mosaic of images, for the rough match of two images,to determine the overlapping area, in the range of the image mosaic, afterwards the image mosaic, the seam is eliminated by rapid and simple weighted smoothing algorithm between two images. Through numerical examples indicate that the method in fabric image mosaicing aspects have better effect.

articleTitle: NC milling deformation analysis of aluminum alloy thin-walled components based on orthogonal cutting experiments on a vertical machining center
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Because of their poor rigidity, the deformation of thin-walled workpieces caused by cutting force in NC milling is the main factor that decreases machining precision and increases aeronautical product cost. The straight side walls of aluminum LY12CZ workpieces are machined on a vertical machining center THA5656 and their errors are analyzed. Based on orthogonal tests, the deformation characters of the thin-walled workpieces are discussed under different cutting conditions. The research can provide support for machining deformation control and machining simulation model verification.

articleTitle: Gas detection by carbon nanotube gas-ionization sensor based on Lyapunov exponent
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, a novel method utilizing a multi-walled carbon nanotube (MWNT) gas-ionization sensor based on Lyapunov exponent algorithm was proposed for argon, ethanol, acetone, and ammonia detection. The sensor was used as anodic sensor. Responses of MWNT sensor to four gases was measured and processed by Lyapunov exponent. Experimental results showed that the MWNT sensor array based on Lyapunov exponent could distinguish gas species successfully.

articleTitle: Investigation on relevance between CET-4 and College English course test score
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: English is an important compulsory course for students of non-English majors. College english test band 4 (CET-4) is a large-scale standardized test designed and developed by the National College English Testing Committee (NCETC), and it were directed and supervised by the Department of Higher Education of the Ministry of Education. CET-4 is very important for college students and teachers. The relevance between college english course test score and CET-4 score is explored based on linear regression analysis in this paper. Linear regression analysis is introduced and the figures of correlation between college english course test score and CET-4 score are ploted as scatter diagram and linear regression analysis model. Base on the data of eight classes, it is indicate that the CET-4 score is tightly related to the college english course test score.

articleTitle: A Grey Machine Learning Model with application to time series
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The Grey Machine Learning Model based Variable Separable (VSGML) is presented in this paper. The VSGML's function set is composed of the variable separable function. The Divide-and-Conquer architecture based Radial Basis Function (DCRBF) Network is constructed to implement VSGML. This DCRBF is composed of several sub-RBF networks which takes each sub-space as its input. The output of DCRBF is the sum of each sub-RBF networks' output. The algorithm of DCRBF is given and its approximation ability also is discussed in this paper. The experimental results have shown that the DCRBF is outperforms the conventional RBF.

articleTitle: MISO control method based on separating feedbacks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, a MISO control method based on separating feedbacks for the mechanisms with flexible components is presented. The method efficiently uses the model information to carve up the feedbacks into two separated sub-control routes, the rigid influence control route and flexible influence control route. Then it makes use of a combination control method of these two sub-control systems. The validity and stability of the designed controller are verified by the simulation of a flexible crank-slider mechanism.

articleTitle: Fast and accurate frequency estimation algorithm for ADCP carrier frequency
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: ADCP is a sonar that attempts to produce a record of water current velocities for a range of depths. When testing the accuracy of ADCP, estimating the carrier frequency of ADCP is required. However, a variety of measurement techniques based on fixed-sampling algorithm, it is difficult to meet the requirements of simple calculation, high speed and accuracy. A new technique is introduced in this paper for frequency estimation algorithm based on Fourier transform and variable sampling rate method. The measurement algorithm avoids complex operation with low computational complexity. Simulation results show that the algorithm is high accuracy, and is suitable for application in estimating the carrier frequency of ADCP.

articleTitle: A method of product quality cooperation management based on holonic
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Along with the intensification of global competition and the complexity of manufacturing products, the cooperation among enterprises becomes more closely, and the range of quality control extends from internal to the external enterprises. To meet the dynamic, open, and cooperation quality control demand, based on holonic theory, the product quality cooperation control model based on holonic is established. By means of the characteristic analysis of this model, the autonomy and cooperative quality control holon are established by the analysis of cooperation operation among holons to improve the ability and efficiency of product quality control. The communication mechanism and cooperation mechanism of product quality cooperation control model based on holonic is constructed by physical channel to realize cooperation quality control. Finally, the simulation system of the product quality cooperation control model based on holonic can be demonstrated and validated by Flexsim software. It shows the proposed method can satisfy the requirements of product quality cooperation control in modern manufacturing mode, and it can provide a support for effectively quality management.

articleTitle: A streaming media play-out based on the adjustment of receiver control algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Focus on the discontinuity of streaming media play-out which caused by network delay and delay jitter, an improved play-out control algorithm is proposed in order to keep streaming media play-out smoothly, which based on the adjustment of receiver play-out speed. In the algorithm, a fine granularity adjustment of streaming media playback rates according to the occupied buffer level and the use of play-out speed control sequence is adopted to eliminate the intention of buffer underflow or overflow. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is more effect to avoid the skip and stop, and keep the playback smoothly.

articleTitle: A new STAP method for nonhomogeneous clutter environment
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To solve the problem of nonhomogeneous clutter suppression for moved target detection in the airborne phased array, this paper presents a new space time adaptive processing (STAP) method which is named D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>AR. This method firstly filters the target information of cell under test (CUT) based on the phase information of target. Then constructs the AR model to obtain the clutter characteristic. Finally gets the space orthogonal to the clutter subspace based on the AR filter coefficients. This method doesn't require the adjacent training data and is suited for nonhomogeneous clutter environment. The simulation results demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Localized defects detection of rolling element bearing using combination Harmonic wavelets
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Combination Harmonic wavelets are demonstrated to be a class of analytic wavelet in this paper. It can also be used to the envelope-demodulation analysis of mechanical fault vibration signals, in addition to usually used complex Morlet wavelet. We use combination Harmonic wavelets to design a localized defect detector for the rolling element bearing, which integrates a comb-filter and a envelope-demodulator for a periodical amplitude-modulating vibration signals. It has been shown that this detector can effectively detect the spalling or pit defects on the races of the rolling element bearing.

articleTitle: Study on three-dimensional energy receiving system for capsule endoscope
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A wireless capsule endoscope for diagnosing human gastrointestinal tract is a great break-through. The system overcomes some disadvantages of the traditional push endoscope and causes less comfortlessness for patients. At present, the efficiency and stability of the energy receiving system of MEMS are still handicaps in practical applications and need improving. In this paper, a detailed analysis of three-dimensional energy receiving system for the endoscope is presented. Energy receiving performances of the three-dimensional secondary coil in the wireless energy transmission system for MEMS are studied. The coupling coefficient between the transmitting coil and one of the three windings of the receiving coil are actually measured under different working conditions such as different angles, by a self-made measuring circuit. The experimental results confirm that three orthometric windings of the receiving coil can compensate each other effectively for different attitudes. Afterwards a rectifying circuit is designed and fabricated in order to make use of the voltages generated from the three windings to power the MEMS. After measuring the output voltage of each rectifying circuit, the actual power consumption is calculated at different spatial attitudes. The experimental results prove that the efficiency and stability of the three-dimensional receiving system represented in this paper can meet practical requirements.

articleTitle: Flocking of muti-agents with obstacle avoidance based on limit-cycle
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The control of flocking motion must be effective to avoid the various obstacles, and maintain the formation to the target point. A decentralized control method is used to control intelligent groups distributed. The topology model of dynamic network of intelligent groups has been combined with artificial potential field.The control algorithm for obstacle avoidance has been improved. Limit-cycle method for flocking motion with obstacle avoidance in global unknown environment is studied. The limitations of the shape of the obstacle have been overcome. And the limit-cycle method makes the swarm avoid obstacles smoothly.

articleTitle: Research for significance and strategies of Yunnan's participation in the Greater Mekong sub-regional sport cooperation
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Yunnan province is a cooperation link between china and other countries which are in the Greater Mekong Sub-region. However, currently, it does not share china's economic strength, developmental momentum and fruits of opening to the outside word with these countries effectively. While, the content and depth of cooperation will have been strengthened if enhance collaboration in sports area, which has high significance to help Yunnan to play well the role and accomplish the mission given by the State. For the purpose of leading to relevant departments and experts to place a higher value on sports cooperation. This research analyzes the present situation, infrastructures and significance in The Grater Mekong sub-regional sports cooperation of Yunnan province, also put forward the corresponding strategies and suggestion.

articleTitle: Bit-rate reduction using psychoacoustical masking model in Frequency Domain Linear Prediction based Audio Codec
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Frequency Domain Linear Prediction (FDLP) gives an approximation of the Hilbert envelopes of a signal. FDLP based Codec works with long temporal segments and keeps the information carried by the time-domain envelopes very well. The codec gives good quality of the reconstructed signal, but coding efficiency is not enough. Here Frequency masking is introduced to FDLP based codec to reduce the bit-rate. Frequency masking is a hearing phenomenon that the hearing threshold of a sound will increase if an intense sound exists simultaneously. The psychoacoustics model is used to estimate the hearing threshold and the absolute threshold of hearing (ATH) of the FDLP carrier signals, and bit allocation for frequency sub-bands FDLP carrier signal is calculated according to the threshold and ATH. 5% bit-rate reduction is obtained with the application of the frequency masking. Perceptual Evaluation of Audio Quality (PEAQ) and Multiple Stimuli with Hidden Reference and Anchor (MUSHRA) test are carried out to evaluate the performance.

articleTitle: The finite element analysis of stress concentration factor for the V-notch on the inner surface of cylindrical shell
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper builds the three-dimensional finite element model of the single axial V-shaped groove on inner surface of cylindrical shell. It is obtained the influences laws of the stress concentration factor affected by the dimensionless quantities of the geometric configuration of the cylindrical shell and the groove by analyzing numerical simulation results. The function expression of the stress concentration factor Kt is fitted to provide a valuable reference for the calculation of the stress concentration factor for the V-notch on the inner surface of cylindrical shell.

articleTitle: A feature-based method for urban landscape visualization
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Urban environments present big challenges to visualization systems, because of the widely varying visibility conditions, large amounts of data and requirements of Immersion, Interaction and Imagination. This paper introduces a feature-based method for urban landscape visualization. The central concept is that of pre-classification of features, into irregular features, regular features and terrain. CAD software is used for modeling irregular features, and constructive solid geometry for modeling the regular features. The DEM and images are applied in terrain modeling. This method has been successfully applied for building a visualization system of Campus of East China Normal University, China. It is proved simple, fast and realistic, which has a broad range of applications.

articleTitle: Ambiguity function analysis for MCPC radar signal
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The MCPC signal using Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing structure has caught much attention of researchers recently since it has good anti-jamming capability, high spectrum efficiency and simple digital processing. This paper deduces ambiguity function expression of MCPC radar signal analyses its performance and discuss the influence of individual parameter on ambiguity function in both range and Doppler domain. Derived conclusion can provide theoretical basis for the waveform design and signal processing of the MCPC signal.

articleTitle: The design and research of a straw chopper returning corn stubble to the field
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With reference to the advantages of the side edge curve of the scimitar-chip rotary blade and the cutting edge curve of scimitar-chip, this paper analyzes the working principle and features of the straight knives, machetes and rotary blade. In order to reduce power consumption and increase corn stubble broken pass rate, this paper designed a new type of corn stubble chopper tool (crescent knife), and conducted fieldwork test. The results show that: the field operation of this new type of field straw chopper with corn stubble is effective, and the power consumption is low so that it is suitable to be widely used.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of circular quartz crystal with arc force and force -frequency sensitive experiments
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Stress distribution of the circular quartz crystal in various regions was performed by using ANSYS finite element simulation when plus with different arc force along x axis. The ratio of stress variety for the center of three electrodes on the chip was calculated. Frequency change of three electrodes was tested on experiment, and the ratio of force-frequency sensitivity coefficient has been calculated. The comparison with experimental data shows that: the results of ANSYS simulation analysis are similar with the experiment, and the maximum relative error is 1.09%. So this proves that ANSYS simulation analysis is feasible.

articleTitle: Sequential speaker clustering based on second order statistical measures
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper presents an investigation on the sequential clustering, based on second order statistical measures, for the task of speaker diarization. This clustering technique, which represents the second part of a global system of speaker indexing, is made for gathering the homogeneous segments obtained during the segmentation step. Most existing clustering systems are based on hierarchical clustering as agglomerative techniques. Such systems present two problems: finding the stopping criterion and choosing the threshold of clustering decision. In this research work, we try to resolve the first problem (stopping criterion) by proposing a sequential clustering approach based on second order statistical measures in order to gather the similar homogeneous segments (obtained by the segmentation process). At the end, each class will contain the global intervention of only one speaker in the entire audio document. Our sequential clustering approach uses a mono gaussian measure, called μ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Gβ</sub>, which is able to assess the degree of similarity between the different homogeneous segments. Experiments are done on a subset of Hub4 Broadcast-News database and the corresponding results show that the implemented algorithms are interesting for the task of speaker clustering.

articleTitle: Approach to controlling robot by artificial brain based on parallel evolutionary neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A novel approach to building an intelligent robot, which can be expected to show many intelligent behaviors as people do, is proposed. This approach exploits a computer device called Tesla S1070, a personal supercomputer, to control a humanoid robot named NAO. The Tesla S1070 acts as a human head, in which thousands of artificial neural network, the basis of an artificial brain (AB), evolve in a parallel way and act as a human brain. The CUDA (Computing Unified Device Architecture) technology is employed to solve the key problem, i.e., how to improve the evolution speed of thousands of neural network. The general architecture of this approach, the reason why the Tesla S1070 is selected, and how the data structure of neural net modules should be modified to meet the demands of CUDA are presented in detail. This approach provides a method both for controlling a robot by the AB, and for demonstrating the power of the AB through a robot.

articleTitle: Rough control for hot rolled laminar cooling
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Aim of laminar cooling is to make hot rolled strip from high finishing roll temperature to requested coiling temperature, it makes strip obtain satisfactory microstructure performance and mechanical property. On the view of modern control, laminar cooling control is an uncertain-information, large-lag, multi-variable, nonlinear and complex control problem. By the rough set theory, the decision-making table, which includes the diagnostic state and the corresponding control strategy of operator in the laminar cooling control of hot rolled, is reduced. And the rough control rules on the laminar cooling are get. The simulation shows the rules can apply on the laminar cooling control, and the application of the rough set can get fast the feedforward control number of water section in the laminar cooling.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent design system based on modular product case
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Be aimed at the issue how to make full use of the existing product resources to respond rapidly the users' requirements, one rapid intelligent design approach is presented. This approach combines case based reasoning with modular technology and focuses on the following researches: the modeling approach of product model, the relation-driven among model parammeters, the case variant modification technology of similar product case. Also, this approach is to develop the case intelligent design system based on the modular product case, and then to achieve the rapid design and analysis of product. Further, the proposed approach is going to be tested by integrating with the farm dump truck produced by one certain machinery Co., Ltd.

articleTitle: Computing location and orientation from 2-d line correspondence using dual quaternion
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
