abstract: In this thesis, we use dual quaternion to solve location and orientation, which replaces the traditional way of coplanarity condition and least square solution. Through proposing filtering Method, we use only one camera to find the location and orientation by comparing the projection of lines respect to 2-D Camera systems.

articleTitle: Fast Hough transform algorithm for radar detection
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, a fast algorithm for radar detection based on line Hough transform is presented. Unlike the traditional method, the idea of our proposed is that the point of data space should be mapped into the Hough parameter space of slope and intercept, where the relative position of the points in the data space is preserved. Then, only one time transformation of coordinate is employed to get the position of a batch points in parameter space. Therefore, the computation burden is significantly reduced. In addition, the detector performance is investigated. Finally, we illuminate the reduction of computation in details.

articleTitle: Evolution characteristics of agricultural industrial clusters: A perspective from the small world network model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Agricultural industrial clusters exhibit the characteristics of complex system, and the features of its evolution reveal those of complex system evolution. Therefore, the complex system evolution model for agricultural industrial clusters with geographical attachment preference related to geographic locations may lender a comparatively sound interpretation of the internal mechanism of the evolution. The paper studies the evolution of agricultural industrial cluster on the basis of the small world network model, and points out that due attention should be paid to the roles of government, non-market factors and non-technology factors in the evolution of the cluster.

articleTitle: Frequency estimation for high dynamic GPS signals based on vector tracking
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A method of estimating high dynamic GPS signal parameters based on Vector Frequency Lock Loop (VFLL) is proposed. Instead of tracking the Doppler frequency of individual channel using the traditional loop, the VFLL tracking the velocity, acceleration .etc states of the GPS receiver from the measure value of all the channels. In vector mode, the navigation processor controls the carrier numerically controls oscillators (NCOs) based on the most recent velocity solution of the receiver. The major advantage of this method is that the velocity estimation from all the channels can be more accurate than Doppler frequency estimation from individual channel. In this paper the VFLL architecture is given, and the system dynamics equation and measure equation of the navigation processor are discussed in detail. The performance of the VFLL is tested using simulation, because it is inherently scenario dependent. From the simulation results, it can be seen that estimation performance is improved compared with scalar method.

articleTitle: Estimating wind velocity from limited aircraft flight data
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Maximum likelihood (ML) and maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimators are described for the estimation of wind velocity using position, and airspeed measurements from flight data recordings. The estimators are demonstrated using simulated flight data and experimental flight data from a high-altitude sailplane flight.

articleTitle: Design of flexible assembly control systems based on Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The design of flexibly assembly control systems based on Ethernet is introduced in the paper. First, the whole scheme of the flexible assembly system is presented, then, the designs of the telegram structure and contents and processing functions are expatiated, the general mechanism is focused on for the communication handshake between the super-ordinate system and PLC system by the Ethernet. The design of the whole system is universal, reliable and flexible.

articleTitle: Synchronization of chua's circuit system with dead-zone in the control input
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A variable structure control (VSC) method is designed to synchronize a chua's circuit system with dead-zone in the control input, and a necessary and sufficient condition which can guarantee the stabilization of the sliding mode is obtained. By using VSC method, a new variable structure control law is proposed to ensure the occurrence of the sliding mode for the error dynamics even when the system with dead-zone nonlinearity control input, it is guaranteed that under the proposed control law, two identical modified chua's system achieve synchronization. The proposed control law has less conservatism and can eliminate the chattering of the state error obviously. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Some thoughts on “Algorithm Design and Analysis” teaching reform
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: “Algorithm Design and Analysis” is one of the core curriculum of computer science, how to teach this course, for teachers, it is a very important research topic. In this paper, we approach the problem from teaching content, teaching methods, curriculum design, assessment mode etc. At last, we have the proportion of normal operations from 30% to 50%, and make the appropriate division, here mainly include classroom discussion 10%, normal operations 20%, curriculum design and on the machine account for 20%. For each of the criteria for judging the need to grasp a fundamental principle, which requires students to reflect the individuality, innovation, accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on battery power optimization method for wireless Ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Resource optimization plays vital role in wireless Ad hoc network since such type of network are not having resources in ample amount. Working with limited resources like bandwidth, battery power, buffer space etc. create problems during data transmission in the network. Battery power may decrease the overall life time of a network. In this paper we have proposed two algorithms Select_Node. Select_Node find out how many nodes want to participate in data transmission and Total_Minimum_Power calculates the total power consumption in wireless Ad hoc network. These two algorithms help to minimize the consumption of large battery power as well as increases the overall life time of the network.

articleTitle: Research on three-parameter power function equivalent energy method for high temperature strain fatigue
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Researched on Manson-Coffin equation, the tensile hysteresis energy damage function method, walker strain life prediction model, the three-parameter power function formula and the three-parameter power function energy method, a three-parameter power function equivalent energy method is put forward, specific algorithm and the solution process are given. The method is validated by the low-cycle fatigue test data of GH4133 material under the strain ratio of −1 and 0.44 at 250°C. Through the analysis of life dispersion coefficient and standard deviation, the method has higher calculation accuracy and does not require an average strain or stress amendment It is able to fit fatigue test data with different strain ratio at the same time.

articleTitle: The rotating machines measuring speed system based on microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A new method to measure the speed of rotating machines based on microcomputer and quadrature encoder is presented in this paper. The hardware and software of the measuring speed system are described. This circuit contains active crystal, quadrature decoder chips HCTL-2020 and LCD module. It can meet the requirement of the general speed measuring system. It can also display the speed situation on the LCD module. We can appropriately modify the program to make different displaying model on the LCD module. The speed measuring circuit also provides two interfaces of 9 pins and 15 pins, which is compatible with any other quadrature encoders.

articleTitle: Uniform convergence method for model with small parameter and Robin boundary condition
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Model with small parameter and Robin boundary condition is considered. This is a multi-scale problem. The presence of small parameter leads to boundary layer phenomena. In order to discrete robin boundary condition and improve the order of uniform convergence, first transition point, which is very small, is introduced firstly. The domain is divided into the inner boundary layer region and the outside boundary layer region according to second transition point secondly. The new method is proved to be stable and high order uniformly convergent with respect to small parameter finally.

articleTitle: Weft tension test system of rapier loom based on MC68332
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To measure weft tension of a rapier loom exactly during weft insertion, this paper reasonably configures technological parameters for the rapier loom, adopts a weft tension test system composed of MC68332, main shaft rotation angle sensor, tension sensor, data acquisition chip and display to achieve real-time measurement of dynamic weft tension, elaborates the principle and design method of this tension test system and applies this system to test and analyze tension of different wefts of TT96 rapier loom.

articleTitle: An improved dynamical evolutionary algorithm with Multi-parent Crossover
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper proposes an improved dynamical evolutionary algorithm ( IDEA) based on Multi-parent Crossover. Besides preventing premature convergence effectively and keeping the population in good distribution, the new algorithm makes full use of Multi-parent Crossover, overcoming the disadvantage of big searching dead zone existed in conventional mutation model. The numerical results show IDEA not only has good performance and a high degree of reliability while dealing with various complex problems, but also is superior to any other published results.

articleTitle: Some practice and ideas on education reform of numerical analysis course
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: As a required course in polytechnic schools, “Numerical Analysis” is the bridge between the practical application and mathematic theories. Based on the course features and some problems encountered in the teaching process, we carried out some research on education reforms, and put forward some ideas on teaching content and teaching methods. All these achieved good results in teaching practice.

articleTitle: Garment industry oriented clothes shape classifying by cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Based on research about patterns of garment, patterns were made to achieve data and interval of the bust eases. On the basis of bust eases, a series of shape profiles in different eases of garment were designed and distinguishing experiment was done according to the theory of psychics, which profiles in different eases were distinguished. The shapes in different fit were classified into four clusters: tight fit, fit, little loose and loose. The results of experiment were analyzed by k-means cluster method and quantitative classification based on bust ease was achieved. It opens our mind to make garment research by data mining method. A new method for garment fit research and classification exploration of outline shape was brought forward, which it offers reference for garment industry and research for automatic computer distinguishing technology.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of an anti-replay method based on WIA-PA network
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Replay attack is one of the most common and the most dangerous attack in wireless industrious network. Most previous methods only consider the replay attack itself, not considering the security of the whole system and the energy consumption. In this paper, we introduce the third-party detection modul to monitor and analyze all the packets of the network to decide whether to use the local anti-replay attack modul. In the local anti-replay attack modul, we construct the anti-replay packets in order to use the improved anti-replay window protocol. Through filtering some serious delay packets, we can reduce the number of discarded good messages. Simulation results indicate this improved protocol is indeed increasing the detection rate of the replay packets.

articleTitle: Synchronization of the unified chaotic system via the exponential observer
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The concept of exponential synchronization is introduced and chaos synchronization of the unified chaotic system using the exponential observer is investigated in this paper. Based on the time-domain method, a proper state observer for the unified chaotic system is designed to ensure the global exponential stability of the synchronization error system. The exponential convergence rate can be given as any positive constant in advance. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A framework of virtual manufacturing in the days of electronic business
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Virtual manufacturing (VM) is an integrated system to enhance the decisions and controls ability in manufacturing enterprises. It develops with the current electronic business. To study the impacts on VM by electronic business, this paper summarizes the typical changes of manufacturing. Based on the changes and functions of VM, a new application framework of virtual manufacturing is proposed. The framework is composed with design, production and control models in which some online communication units like online co-design with customers, collaborative production with partners and co-work with suppliers etc. are included. The design of the new VM framework is better suitable for electronic business environment and might promote the progress of modern manufacturing. For the implementation aspect, the key technologies are finally explained.

articleTitle: Remote controllable CNC power design
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper used ATMega8L as the core controller, achieved the functions such as preset keyboard, the step adjustment with coarse adjustment and fine-tuning coordination and LCD liquid crystal synchronize display voltage preset value and the communication with PC. The output voltage range is 0–15V, the maximum output current is 1A, the step value is 0.1V. The system has advantages of reliable, simple operation, high control precision, practical and widely used and so on. Not only insure the perfect inner performance, but also has diverse and specific external characteristics and the external interface, which determines such kinds of power system has the eclectic essence of many disciplines, and has advantages of simple operation, low cost, can be remote control through the network, and can be applied to many occasions.

articleTitle: Research on architecture of Business Service Management System and Service Level Agreement
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Nowadays, quality of IT operation has become a key factor which limits business process in enterprises and office efficiency in government. This thesis will first introduce traditional models of IT operation, point out problems in them. Then we propose architecture of a new model of IT operation: Business Service Management System, which is based on the idea of IT service. At last, the building and practice of Service Level Agreement in the architecture will be elaborated in details.

articleTitle: Study on method of recover data from figure by image processing technology
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In many papers, data were given by figure which can not read data directly. In most situations data can only be acquired by author, which is inconvenient and time-delayed. As to the papers of many years ago, to ask for data from author is almost impossible. So recovering data from figure is the most practical way. This paper introduces the data recover process using the image processing technology. The authenticity is guaranteed using matlab program. It is a simple approach to get data from figure.

articleTitle: Urban land use change detection based on RS&GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Urban land use change may influence natural phenomena and ecological processes. Decreasing of cultivated land area in Chengdu is one of the critical problems in recent years. The objective of this study is to detect land use changes between 1992 to 2008 using satellite images of Landsat TM/ETM+. The land use maps of 1992 waw collected from 1:50000 digital maps and Arc/View 3.2 software. TM/ETM+ satellite data were used to generate land use map. The images quality assessment and georeferencing were performed on images. Different suitable spectral transformations such as rationing, PCA, Tasseled Cap transformation and data fusion were performed on the images in ENVI4.0 and ERDAS IMAGE 8.5 software. Image classification was done using supervised classification maximum likelihood and minimum distance classifier utilizing original and synthetic bands resulted from diverse spectral transformation. The overlaying map of land use change shows that intensity of conversion of arable lands to built-land increased, and its speed of spatio-temporal change of urban land use is notable.

articleTitle: A novel multiple sink nodes placement strategies based on Gene Expression Programming for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Wireless sensor network is a new type of network with embedded system, wireless communication, distributing computing and micro sensor technology. In order to understand principles and describe theory of wireless sensor network node, after analyzing components and signal processing course in wireless sensor network node, the signal models of nodes were studied. A real application node of wireless sensor network node based on Gene Expression Programming processor was introduced. The work affords positive significance in theory and application for wireless sensor network node.

articleTitle: A novel real-time database memory management approach
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, real-time memory, the storage structure of the database to start, introduces the real-time memory database of the three kinds of memory management methods and their advantages and disadvantages of analysis, to improve the memory pool distribution method to reduce memory fragmentation take full advantage of the memory purposes.

articleTitle: Improved machine learning algorithm and its application in CPR prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Crack propagation rate (CPR) is important parameter in material speciality, establishing fatigue crack propagation rate is the key to forecasting structure fatigue lifetime, many approximate fitting models are used to calculate CPR, nine parameters fatigue crack propagation rate model and McEvily model are typical representatives, they are widely applied at present, but it is very complex to realize these models, partial derivative must be calculated and there is large deviation between fitted static parameter and actual value and physical conception isn't clear. In this paper, in accordance with the disadvantage above methods, we presented optimal common machine learning algorithm (least squares support vector machine) method for fatigue crack propagation rate forecast, Complicated and strong nonlinear fatigue crack propagation rate curve was simulated by network design and conformation of least squares support vector machine learning algorithm and the optimized SVM parameters were selected. Two prediction examples of material A and material B are simulated to validate its efficiency, the experiment shows improved SVM had excellent ability of nonlinear modeling and generalization, the mean relative error is 0.1074% by calculating, it provided an economical, practical and reliable approach for material fatigue design.

articleTitle: Research and practice for teaching management pattern of combining talent training to employment training
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This With the “College Training” into the campus, many contradictions between the school teaching day-to-day and practical training of university students have become increasingly conspicuous. In this paper, the “Double U talent training” project for the successful implementation of the case, we discussed the critical and problem-solving methods and strategies from the training objectives, teaching plans and teaching management, and provided a value experience for local engineering colleges to support college students training.

articleTitle: Research on stability of financial management system based on graph theory
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: It is well known that sound financial management system is very essential for enterprises, so how to ensure stable financial management system becomes a necessary goal in business management. Because financial management system itself is a vastly complicated system, the reciprocal relationship among key elements in financial management system must be researched so as to seize precisely and forecast its operation laws. In this paper, the author construct a model based on graph theory to research on stability of financial management system. The model focuses on bewriting the change of financial management system, predicting future financial management system, and looking for strategy in order to acquire stable financial management system. At the same time, some academic recommendations are made to improve financial management system.

articleTitle: A production scheduling system modeling approach based on virtual manufacturing cells
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Cellular manufacturing is an effective approach to improve production flexibility and efficiency in today's production environment of small lot-size and multi-species. A production scheduling system modeling approach based on virtual manufacturing cells is proposed in this paper. Object-oriented architecture is adopted in system design. Production jobs are grouped into virtual manufacturing cells. Taking manufacturing cells as management units, by analyzing scheduling tasks in cells and using current scheduling methods, the complexity of production scheduling problem can be reduced, and based on this, a dynamic production scheduling system is designed accordingly.

articleTitle: Mechanical stress analysis of port crane based on the condition of temperature field
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper systematically study the calculative theory of of large-scale port crane's the temperature field and thermal stress, Use the finite element software ANSYS to mode and analyse the large-scale port crane under the temperature field and temperature stress. Carry out a detailed study to results of the analysis and determine the impact of temperature stress on port crane structure. The analytic results show the temperature impact has a non-negligible effect on the structural strength of the port crane, which is likely to result in the main factors of the local structure's cracking.

articleTitle: A new fast segmentation algorithm (for colorful images) based on characteristic of dispersion of RGB
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A new image segmentation algorithm is presented based on characteristic of dispersion of RGB(Red, Green, Blue), utilizing the information of the colorful image to achieve fast segmentation. With tow images an example, firstly, in the original image, it gets the sum of all pixels' RGB dispersion, then that is normalized into grads image. In the histogram of RGB dispersion the characteristic is Bi-peak. Based on this, using one iterative algorithm automatically selects the optimal segmentation threshold. Experimental results indicate that this algorithm can segment colorful image accurately and fast, and adaptable for checking of high-speed moving object, which is of great value.

articleTitle: High-performance instruction-set simulator for TMS320C62x DSP
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The instruction-set simulator (ISS) for DSP is essential to the exploration of DSP micro-architecture and DSP-centric system, just as that for the general-purpose processor. As the mainstream DSPs have developed instruction-level parallelism via very-long instruction word (VLIW), greater challenges are facing design of such simulators than that for superscalar ones. The ISSs not only define the behavior but also have to depict the timing of each instruction exactly at level of pipeline-cycle, which leads to performance penalty consequentially. A high-performance ISS has been proposed for TMS320C62x DSP, a VLIW-based DSP from TI. The proposed one has employed a unified and parameterized scheme to define all kinds of timing information, including timing of instruction-issue, delay-slot, etc. As compared to the conventional pipeline-based simulator, the proposed one was shown to achieve higher performance by more than 40%.

articleTitle: Discussion on conjunctive dispatch model of surface water and groundwater in Huangshui River basin
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Combination with the actual situation of Huangshui River basin, to discuss and establish a combined dispatching model of surface water and ground water on the basis of water supply criterion. After calculation of the model by using the data in 1997, the results indicate that combined dispatching of surface water and groundwater in Huangshui River Basin can obtain efficient utilization of water resources and prevent over-exploitation of ground water.

articleTitle: Development of the tube bender of based on PCI-1240
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: PCI-1240 is a 4-axis motion control card based on PCI bus. It is suitable for tube bender controlling system. To solve the problems of complexity in controlling and complicated operation in the conventional tube bender, a new multi-motor based on PCI-1240 is developed. With the establishment of the instruction code, a multi-motor driving mechanism and the controlling of reading bending data are applied in the new tube bender, which employs three servo motors. With the three mechanisms controlling, the machine structure is simplified. The tube quality is improved. The productivity is promoted. And mechanical-electrical integration level of the tube bender is enhanced.

articleTitle: Private equity investment selection game base on grey assessment in agricultural production and processing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper analysis the two stage private equity projects selection decision-making problem in agricultural production and processing enterprises. Analysis the private equity investment projects selection risk in agricultural production and processing enterprises, come down the risk and return to management, operation, strategy, transaction and investment cost. Build a private equity investment projects selection evaluation model base on risk-weight investment return using grey assessment. Get the optimal solution of risk-weight double objective investment selection evaluation model. Boils down the private equity investment game to incomplete and dynamic game: signaling game. Get the combination perfect Bayesian equilibrium solution. An example is used to demonstrate the models in this paper.

articleTitle: Constrained optimization with Election campaign algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, we present a new method using Election campaign algorithm (ECA) combining with the dynamic penalty method to solve the nonlinear constrained optimization problems. The proposed approaches are validated using several examples taken from the optimization literature, and our results are compared with those obtained by particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO). Our comparative study indicates that ECA verifies its good performance when dealing with constrained optimization problems with constraints.

articleTitle: Hybrid video image coding with importance of block
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: It is a key problem to achieve good image quality without violating compression rate in the design of image coding algorithm. Aiming at the characteristics of image monitoring system, a new hybrid image compression method is proposed in this paper. Based on the distribution of monitoring image content, the two parameters which are brightness rate and motion activity of the current image block are introduced to discriminate the importance regions. Thus, a simple and effective lossless coding is used to compress the block that contains important content, and other unimportant image content is compressed by use of SPIHT coding. Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve image quality of key information. Especially it can be suitable for image transmission with low rate.

articleTitle: Improving the accuracy of verification using fuzzy minutiae-based matching
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Fingerprint images usually have the rare perfect quality. They may be degraded and corrupted with noises because many factors, such as skin and impression conditions, vary. Many methods and algorithms (e.g., preprocessing, postprocessing, and matching methods) are studied for a long time. Among those matching methods, the most well-known matching methods are correlation-based, ridge-feature based, minutiae-based method. This paper only discusses minutiae-based matching method. The previous minutiae-based matching method has the tolerance values that compensate for these unavoidable errors and distortions. Global adaptive threshold that we use for the minutiae-based matching is not efficient to improve the accuracy because the values less than the threshold have the same results. Thus, we use fuzzy membership function to represent the difference between minutiae. In this paper, we present the fuzzy minutiae-based matching method to improve the accuracy of the verification between template and input fingerprint images. All the methods and algorithms described in this paper are implemented using Visual C++ 6.0 and we can reduce the false reject rate by approximately 7% at a false acceptance rate of 1%.

articleTitle: Coil unwinding roller operation system design of the hot rolled leveling line
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A new coil unwinding roller operating framework of leveling line in hot rolled flat sheet metal factory is brought out based on analyzed the shortcomings of the original operating system. The main features of the new system and the design thoughts of its hydraulic operation system are described in detail. A open controlling system is used which is based on soft PLC technology. The constant pressure control strategy and stroke control strategy are used according to the coil unwinding different stages. The strip tension and thickness are taken into controlling process to realize closed loop controlling. The practice has proved that this operating system improve the function of the original system effectively. And it has the value to promotion of application.

articleTitle: Global inverse optimal design of ISS controllers with backstepping approach
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, the problem of input-to-state stability(ISS) of a class of nonlinear system which can be transformed into the strict feedback form is considered, the stable controller is designed by employing a new backstepping procedure and inverse optimal approach. The main tools in our analysis are Legendre-Fenchel transformations, the theory of convex function and Young's inequality.

articleTitle: Artificial intelligence in TV
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The digital television (DTV) semiconductor market is expected to grow to $7.7billion in 2010 and to $10 billion in 2013, an 18% CAGR. Flat screen DTV semiconductor revenue will grow to $6.9 billion in 2010 and to $9 billion in 2013, a 25% CAGR. The above mentioned numbers provide huge opportunity for TV vendors but in a highly-competitive environment. Introducing value added features is one of the ways to address the intense competition. Increase in the number of television channels and programs have provided a number of choices to the consumer, which has led to confusion. The user interested favorite item can be a song, a comedy scene. This may be transmitted in a particular channel while he is viewing another one and the user might end up missing his favorite program. This write-up proposes a solution by which the manufacturer will be able to provide an advanced feature, which ensures the consumers get a great experience without missing their favorites.

articleTitle: Design of integrated positioning LBS mobile terminal based on C8051f340
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper analyzed various components of integrated positioning LBS mobile terminal based on C8051F340, studied pseudo-range integrated positioning of GPS and GLONASS, deduced the combined observation equations and its solution, then used GPRS technology for transmission. Combining with those methods, we finally realized the integrated positioning LBS mobile terminal and tested it later. Experimental analysis shows that the accuracy of integrated positioning is superior to a single positioning system in bad observing conditions. Receiving and sending data of the service information are efficient carried out using GPRS. That such new technique apply to LBS system will enhance the service quality of LBS and promote the development of LBS.

articleTitle: Optimization of analog circuits test mode based on Ants Colony Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, optimization technique based on Ants Colony Algorithms (ACA) was studied for test node selection. The technique yields high faults detection and isolation rates with less number of nodes. This concept can also be applied in the domain of fault dictionary. In the technique proposed, the objective function consists of the fault detection rate defined as the number of faults detected divided by the total number of faults, and the fault isolation rate which is equal to the number of faults isolated divided by the number of fault detected. The transfer probability, also regarded as the rate of change of positions, is equal to the exponential power of - dij where dij is the difference between two points located in a two dimensional space. The updating procedure measures each solution against the last N solutions globally made by ACA. As soon as N solutions are available, their moving average X is computed; each new solution G is compared with X. If G value is lower than X value, the trail level of the last solution's move is increased, otherwise it's decreased. The efficiency of ACA-based technique was proved theoretically and by means of simulation. The source code proving the suitability of ACA was developed in Matlab. The both fault detection and isolation rates were compared with the rates generated by the AdvancedSCH, a platform developed by our research team. The comparison shows that ACA-based technique best suits for test node selection.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of rolling bearing based on the energy operator demodulation approach
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Hilbert transfer is usually used for the demodulated resonance analysis (DRA). Instead of that, in this work the energy operator demodulation method (EODM) is used for DRA to extract features of rolling bearings for fault diagnosis. The principle of DRA was introduced and then the energy operator and EODM were discussed in detail. Finally, the experiments on 406 rolling bearings were carried out to analyze the high-frequency resonance signal with EODM. The results show that EODM is an effective method in fault diagnosis of rolling bearing.

articleTitle: HNM parameter transform for voice conversion using a HMM-WDLT framework
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper presents a Harmonic + Noise Model (HNM)-based voice conversion technique under a Hidden Markov Model-Weighted Deviation Linear Transformation (HMM-WDLT) framework. In a comparative study of four methods of converting the extracted line spectral frequency (LSF) parameters of one speaker to another, the HMM-WDLT achieves the lowest average spectral distortion. A remedial process is developed to enhance the formant characteristics while preserving the variance of the LSF parameters. The frame duration, manifested by the slope of the dynamic time warping (DTW) path, is regarded as an output variable of the conversion function. To take full advantage of the attributes of the HNM, the conversion algorithm fine-tunes the harmonic magnitudes below 2 kHz for each critical band. Listening test reveal that the converted speech successfully catches the speaker's individuality with satisfactory quality.

Author Keywords: hidden Markov model - weighted deviation linear transform

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation for the optimal switching temperature of double-glazed thermotropic window
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A novel kind of smart thermotropic material was developed by a different mixing proportion of hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose (HPMC), Sodium Chloride (NaCl) and pure water. Switching temperature and switching speed from transparent state to light scattering state of thermotropic layer in a double-glazed window was analyzed with numerical simulation and the results show that thermotropic layer has the most significant changes in the heating rate in the first hour, especially in the first half hour. Its temperature reached 36.8°C and it can cause a reduction in light transmittance to below 25% with the optimal mixing proportion of HPMC, NaCl and pure water of 2:10:100 by mass, and the optimal switching temperature of double-glazed thermotropic window is 31.5°C.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of the helical gear of the increasing gear box for wind generator
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Natural vibration characteristics of the helical gear of the increasing gear box for wind generator has an important influence on the normal use of wind turbine. In order to improve the smooth and reliability of the driven system and improve the design efficiency of helical gear, it is very necessary to the natural frequency of gear by modal analysis. In this paper, the model of helical gear is established by using three-dimensional modeling software PRO/E, and through data exchange interface, the model was converted into ANSYS, then the model analysis was carried out and the low natural vibration frequencies and vibration mode were obtained. This is the basis for the design and optimization of the gear transmission system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the upper cross beam of a forging hydraulic press
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: According to the structural characteristics of the upper cross beam on a particular 20MN forging hydraulic press, the beam's strength is checked by the method of materials mechanics. Then the solid modeling is created by the PROE, and analysis is carried out by use of ANSYS software to study the stress and displacement under the nominal pressure. The results show that the finite element method is reliable and a reasonable structure design of the beam is gotten. At the same time, further optimization is suggested.

articleTitle: The efficient numerical simulation of stochastic road excitation to vehicles in time domain
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The future way for vehicle development extremely depends on the virtual prototyping of vehicles. In order to analyze the nonlinear ride dynamics of vehicles, it is necessary to establish the time domain model of stochastic road irregularity as the excitation to the vehicle system. Based on the mathematical theory of the stochastic process, a time domain model of stochastic road irregularities with arbitrary or specified power spectral density (PSD) was constructed by using inverse fast Fourier transfer (IFFT) method, and the model could be expanded to include the information of both the auto-PSD and the cross-PSD. By using the new modeling approach, the resulting bilateral stochastic processes of a road were correlative in the time domain. A simulation example demonstrates the method efficiently and accurately.

articleTitle: Distributed service integration for grid resource brokers
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Grid computing promise the ability to share geographically and organizationally distributed resource to increase effective computational power and resource utilization. However, for the grid computing to be successful, it is very important to provide middleware services that assist grid users to easily interact with grid environments. The paper presents a utility quality of service for grid resource brokers. Resource Brokers on the grid consult a number of distributed information service to select the best data source based on user requirements. The consultation task increases the design complexity of Resource Brokers. We have designed and implemented a utility quality of service for grid resource brokers to hide the underlying complexity of the grid resources from users and to meet not only grid user's requirements but also resource owner's policies. It focuses on the discovering and scheduling dynamic resources scattered across multiple organizations. Furthermore, it can be integrated with various scheduling services.

articleTitle: Research on the social effect of pro-poor tourism
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Pro-poor tourism is regarded as a strategy to counter poor in China. The core of this strategy is to improve the benefits of poor in the development of tourism industry. Thus the social effect induced by pro-poor tourism is more important than the direct economic effect along with the development of tourism. This paper emphasized on the social effect of pro-poor tourism and made analysis from three aspects. As to the personal development in depressed regions, pro-poor tourism would make for the poverty population out of psychological poor, knowledge poor and power poor, to change their mind and improve personal quality. As to the social development of depressed regions, pro-poor tourism would make for alleviating the situation of labor surplus, promoting outward cultural communication and improving the civilization degree. As to the whole society, pro-poor tourism would promote the realization of social equity in larger scope, narrowing the gap among different regions, promoting the horizontal economic corporation and outward opening, and setting up harmonious tourism ecological system. The social effect analysis of pro-poor tourism strategy would serve as the reference for policy makers.

articleTitle: A model for international relationships based on Intelligence Ball theory
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to service in the analysis and simulation of modern international relationship by using high-tech cluster of information technology, A Intelligence Ball Computation Model (IBCM) is used to describe the international relationship, this approach leads to the usage of numerical methods in this paper. The idea of the design is to combine Complex Adaptive Systems theory at the microcosmic level with qualitative System Dynamics at the macrocosmic level. International-field Agent (it corresponds to the international community in the real world.) and Ball Agents encapsulate the microcosmic model of activities at in Politics of Military Confrontation. Force Agents (countries or regions) and Environment Agent (strategic environment) encapsulate the microcosmic world. The distinct Force Agents carry on the interactions of Five Elements through the medium -- the International-field Agent, which reflect the confrontation in Ball Agents on the International-field, hereby this implement the link between the macrocosmic level and the microcosmic level. We used a SA-PSO Algorithm to optimize strategies for Multi-Agents.

articleTitle: Research and realization on control system of reactor
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Reactor is a typical process with pure delay and great inertia. Due to the influence of uncertain factors, its variants are difficult to control. Taking the inner temperature of reactor as controlled variable, this paper combined the PC with the controller, using dynamic PID algorithm to control the temperature. The content is mainly about the development of user interface (UI) based on VB6.0 and the design of regulator based on C8051F020 MCU, including hardware structure of controller, software design, serial communication, dynamic data-graph display and so on. Experiments on the reactor show that the design of software, hardware and dynamic PID algorithm are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on process route designing and production line management based workflow driven
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To realize the aim of rapid design, data management, and process management of process route for those small and medium-sized contractors which produce for group enterprises cheaply, a kind of information system architecture based on process route driven is proposed in this paper. On the basis of workflow technology, the information management system which includes the visual process route modeling tool, BOM (Bill Of Material)management of jig & fixture on the production line(process route), the production management of process route, the function of part quality, workload checking and calculating is developed. Finally, the running flow and key implemented technology of the whole system are introduced.

articleTitle: The building of Customer Relationship Management system based on OLAP
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper introduces the concepts of OLAP into Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system and puts forward a framework of CRM system based on OLAP, which effectively resolves insufficient heterogeneous compatibility and heavy workload on the server in the traditional CRM system. It elaborates on the working process of CRM system based on OLAP with a specific example. It summarizes the CRM system based on OLAP' characteristics compared with the traditional CRM system.

articleTitle: Research on operating control strategy of SRM based on mixed-conduction mode
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A new operating mode is proposed in this paper which mixed single-phase and two-phase conduction mode together based on 8/6 structure Switched Reluctance Motor (referred to as SRM). Compared with the single-phase or two-phase conduction mode, the commutation interval of SRM is narrowed and positioning accuracy of Switched Reluctance Motor Drive (referred to as SRD) position detection is improved by this new mixed-conduction mode, using a method to subdivide the stepping angle of SRM. Finally, the commutation logic based on mixed-conduction mode is proposed through the analysis of motor winding inductance wave, which provides the main theoretical basis for the application of mixed-conduction mode used in 8/6 structure SRM and it is also demonstrated by simulation of 8/6 SRM.

articleTitle: Identifying Chinese personal names based on Support Vector Machines and transformation-based error-driven learning
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Recognition of Chinese personal name is emphasis and difficulty for unknown words recognition. If the problem is effectively solved, then it will improve the precision of unknown words recognition. The paper presents a method of Chinese name recognition based on Support Vector Machines (SVM) and transformation-based error-driven learning. Using the transformation-based learning approach to correct the identification results of SVM. Transformation rules effectively deal with the special cases of language phenomenon and improve the performance of SVM. Experiments show that the method is efficient in identifying person names from Chinese texts. In open test, the precision, recall, and F-measure are improved.

articleTitle: A fast method for the determination of the heat transfer coefficient of external wall
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this study, the main objective is to provide a fast method for the determination of the heat transfer coefficient of external wall based on artifical neural network and the inspection method of using cold box and hot box. Three backpropagation neural networks were modeled and the inputs of the networks for training and testing were considered as the first 3, 4 and 5 sets of data measured in field inspection. The simulation results of ANNs show that the data of the first 4 or 5 hours in measurement are enough for the prediction of the heat transfer coefficients of external wall, and this method reduces inspection duration from 48 to 4 hours with mean absolute error below 5% and can be used in the inspection to replace conventional method.

Author Keywords: Heat transfer coefficient of external wall

articleTitle: A mechatronic levelling system based on parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper focuses on a mechatronic levelling device based on parallel manipulator, which is composed of an active platform and four legs. Based on a kinematic analysis, the degree of freedom (DOF) and position equation are derived through simplifying the structure. Then, the levelling method, one-way rise levelling, is brought forward, which decouples the complex movement of the parallel platform to two independent directions and improves the levelling efficiency. According to the levelling method, the hardware and software of control system are designed and the fuzzy PID control strategy is adopted in order to solve the grave nonlinearity. Finally, a simulation experiment is carried out and the result shows the system has many advantages such as stability and rapidity.

articleTitle: Discussions of the mathematics teaching reform in normal universities under “new curriculum standard”
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The new curriculum standard gives higher requirements to the teaching ability of middle school mathematics teachers, such as: the ability of teaching students how to learn well, applying new teaching theory and modern information technology, and exploiting and using curriculum resources. For this, middle school mathematics teachers should improve their teaching ability to adapt to the new requirements. It demands mathematics teaching reform in normal universities to meet the requirements. In this paper, we give the methods of how to do this from four respects. At the same time, we demonstrate the validity of them.

articleTitle: An automatically requirements acquisition method of process business
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to obtain requirements of the e-government information system accurately, this paper proposes a new requirements modeling method which is based on ontology of the business model on process and domain ontology. By the business model on process, this method could give guidance to the users to describe the reality system in an all-round way, and then translate into requirements model automatically. Thereby the consistency of domain's business requirements and requirements of application software can be assured. This method not only can guarantee the quality of requirements model, but also can increase efficiency of requirements modeling.

articleTitle: Multi-scale entropy analysis on the complexity of blast furnace ironmaking process
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Complexity study of blast furnace is of great importance. This paper employs the multi-scale entropy method to measure the complexity. The results show that it is more reasonable to analyze the complexity at different temporal scales. As the selected blast furnaces (BFs) are concerned, sulfur series is likely to exhibit more complex behavior than silicon series, and large BF tends to be more stable than small BF. The basic descending behaviors of multi-scale entropy of silicon series of two BFs with the scale factors increasing provide a possibility to simplify the silicon prediction issue using multi-scale methods in the future research.

articleTitle: A novel method for extraction of in-pulse feature of LFM signal
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Aiming at the shortly SNR capability of wavelet-ridge in extracting in-pulse features of LFM signal, in this paper, a time-frequency associated analyzed method based on wavelet transform and time-frequency reassignment is proposed.. The method is based on LFM's wavelet scalogram, and combined with time-frequency reassignment and time-frequency ridge. With the help of time-frequency reassignment in improving the time-frequency agglomeration of representations, the SNR capability of wavelet-ridge is enhanced. The result of the emulation experiments approved the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation indicator system for construction of demonstrative building based on Analytic Hierarchy Process theory
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore a scientific and systematized method to assess the level of demonstrative building for energy efficiency. Using Analytic Hierarchy Process theory, this paper presents a description and an application of a general target system and assessment model. A case study of demonstrative building was used to calculate scores and give the level of this demonstrative building. The results of evaluation show that it is quantitatively comparable to other demonstrative building and plays an important role in the determination of the amount of financial subsidies for demonstrative building.

articleTitle: Research in the soft strategy of access to portal website
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A small website can be realized by simple static html. With the enrichment of website operation, especially to big website, the technology including hardware, software, program, database, Webserver and firewall are very important. So such website needs a higher request in framework and performance. A simple way of optimization is upgrade the hardware. However, the reform of arithmetic and framework strategy can also improve the performance of system. The paper put emphases in the discussion of feasible soft optimization to improve the efficient of access to website.

articleTitle: Study on translation quality assessment of German-Chinese translation based on fuzzy theory
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to further study the development of cooperating between China and Germany with the bridge of academic culture communication, Zhejiang University of Science and Technology (ZUST) has been a pilot project of Chinese-German cooperation in application-orientated talent cultivation, which has led to the rise of a number of German-Chinese translation projects. The study of translation quality assessment is beneficial to improve translation quality, get a better understanding of the original text and provide an effective way for evaluating the language transfer mechanics. Under the background of internationalization, the main study of this paper is about establishment of the translation quality assessment model based on fuzzy theory to evaluate its availability in German-Chinese translation practice and be both feasible and effective in practice.

articleTitle: Teaching reform research of mathematics analysis courses
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The Current problems of the mathematics analysis courses in science and engineering colleges and universities is unsatisfactory. People's traditional concepts of mathematical analysis courses need to be updated. This article discussed the teaching content and method of Mathematical analysis and Put forward suggestions for improvement, such as Mathematical culture and numerical experiments bring in teaching, etc.

articleTitle: A liquid DP flow sensor on straight pipe
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To detect water and pesticide flow rate for variable-rate spray, a new type liquid Differential Pressure (DP) flow sensor was introduced in this paper. The main problem that we attempt to solve was on-line flow measurement, to know the flow each moment and adjust pesticide to a desirable flow in the spray system. This new DP flow sensor is composed of a straight pipe with two branch pipes (an upstream branch pipe and a downstream branch pipe) in two ends and a DP sensor. A pressure difference between the upstream branch pipe and the downstream pipe is detected and converted into a voltage signal by the DP sensor. This voltage signal is transmitted to a microprocessor to determine liquid flow rate. Using water as working fluid, the liquid DP flow sensor at a certain dimension has been tested at the temperature of 22.0°C.The experimental results have shown that the presented device is satisfactory to variable sprayer with the measurement errors less than 1%. This liquid DP flow sensor's advantage is simple in structure.

articleTitle: Jumping robot based on the kinematics performance of locust
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The geometrical configurations of the locust, Oedaleus infernalis, were obtained by using the stereomicroscope. The jumping movements of the locust were analyzed from the sequences of the images captured by the high-speed camera. The characteristics of the locust during jumping were discussed, and the jumping parameters of the locusts were gained. The jump of the locust was propelled by the simultaneous extension of the two hind legs powered by the rapid depression movements about the coxa-trochanteral joints. Kinematic analysis of the locust jumping provided critical 3D space point data for modeling and simulation. The model of the locust-like robot was established by the technology of virtual prototype. The velocity, acceleration and force of the hind leg of the locust-like robot during jumping were analyzed. This work may provide the basic theory in developing locust-like robot in structural design. Besides, it provides an important reference to study the other bionic robots.

articleTitle: Design of multi-functional street light control system based on AT89S52 single-chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Presented is a street lights control system based on AT89S52 as control core. It is a combined product of the following technologies: a digital clock, a timer, a Liquid Crystal Display (LCD), a statistics of traffic flowing magnitude, a photosensitive induction, an infrared control and alarm function. This street light system also includes a time cut-out function, and an automatic control pattern for even more electricity conserving, namely when vehicles pass by, the light will turn on automatically, later turn off. This design can save a great amount of electricity compared to streetlamps that keep alight during nights. The design implements traffic flow magnitude statistics without adding any hardware, facilitating transportation condition information collecting. Furthermore, this system has auto-alarm function which will set off if any light is damaged and will show the serial number of the damaged light, thus it is easy to be found and repaired the damaged light.

articleTitle: The control system and data transferring format of digital printing device
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The key problem needed to be solved for digital textile printing technology lies in its low printing speed, which cannot meet the need of textile industry printing. For this problem, in this paper the processing tasks of host-side and device-side of control system are redistributed reasonably, and accordingly, a new direct printing data format is put forward, on the basis of which the inkjet printing data is processed by host-side controller, and the device-side controller directly receives the spraying signal. The features of the corresponding control system of the digital printing machine is analyzed here. By use of this method of task redistribution and the new direct printing data format, not only the printing speed can be increased, but also the control system of printing machine can be simplified, and thus it has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor data fusion approach for terrain match navigation of autonomous underwater vehicles
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to improve the navigation accuracy of an underwater vehicle, a terrain passive integrated navigation system, which consists of strapdown inertial navigation system, underwater terrain map, bathometer, magnetic compass and doppler log is presented. In the integrated system, the position difference of inertial navigation and terrain match are as measurement equation, which adding to the doppler velocity measure equation and magnetic compass course measure equation. And the parameters are estimated using Kalman filter, eliminating the error of navigation system. The simulation results prove that the terrain passive integrated navigation system, as number of navigation device is constant, can reduce the attitude angle error and location error of underwater vehicle effectively, and demand the requirement of high precision and low cost.

articleTitle: A hybrid high-performance embedded Processing System
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the speedup formula, and expand the formula in detail. After discuss the timing problems of parallel computing, we give some designing rules, specially applied to HPEC (high-performance embedded computing) systems. Further analyzing the characteristics of HPEC system, a modular processing architecture is proposed. Due to the development of interconnection technologies, we design a type of hybrid PE (Processing Element) architecture, and describe the compositions of the PE. The implementation methods of the hybrid PE are described. An actual platform is established to certify the feasibility and performance of the system.

articleTitle: Research on building electricity saving by 65% base on BPNN
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With the development of building materials and the increase of the energy efficiency ratio of air conditioner, building electricity saving by 65% has been taken into consideration. In this study, the main objective is to predict buildings electricity consumption potential of building envelope performance parameters and to determine the measures to building electricity saving by 65% by using BP neural networks. A three-layered BPNN was modeled and BPNN toolbox of MATLAB was used for predictions. Results show that BPNN gives satisfactory outputs with successful prediction rate of over 98% and provides the energy efficient measure to reach building electricity saving by 65%.

articleTitle: Head pose estimation in thermal images for human and robot interaction
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Head pose estimation is one of key steps for human and robot interaction because head pose is highly related with the attention of human to robot. Although head pose estimation has progressed in the past few decades, existing algorithms for visual imagery are not fast enough for smooth human and robot interaction. This paper proposes an algorithm to estimate head pose of a previously unseen head from thermal images, motivated by the fact that thermal imagery provides us the possibility to develop light-weight computing algorithm for estimating head pose. The proposed algorithm has multiple merits. Firstly, it is a fully-automatic algorithm. That does not require any manual initialization. Second, its operation is very simple. It recognizes the head pose from a single image. Third, it is a light-weight computing algorithm. This is mainly because it has a fast head localization procedure. The proposed algorithm can estimate head pose at 110 fps. Last, it is a very robust algorithm in head localization. The performance in head pose estimation is promising.

articleTitle: Singularity of a novel five-DOF parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper studies the singularity of a five-degree-of-freedom 3-RRUR parallel manipulator, presents singularity equations and the geometry conditions of singularity of the 3-RRUR parallel manipulator. The input plan is optimized based on the analysis on singularity of the manipulator. The special characteristics in singularity of the parallel manipulator is given. This parallel manipulator can be used to build industrial robots for assembly or dummy axis machine tools with simple symmetry structure, less error accumulating and high rigidness.

articleTitle: Neighbor selecting MAC protocol based on adaptive beamforming for ad hoc network
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A number of media access and routing protocols have been recently proposed for the use with such antennas, and have shown significant performance improvements over the Omni-directional case. This paper presents a novel MAC (Medium Access Control) protocols for nodes equipped with adaptive antenna array in ad hoc network. The protocol relies on the ability of antenna to use DOA (Direction-Of-Arrival) information to beamform by placing nulls in the direction of interferers thus maximizing SINR (Signal to Interference and noise ratio) at the receiver. In this work, we also compare the convergence of beam deflection towards a targeted receiver using the following four beamformers'. Matched Filter (MF), Minimum Variance Distortion less Response (MVDR), Minimum power distortion less response (MPDR), and Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE). Finally, we show that MVDR algorithm has a fast convergence beam with wide beam width towards the receiver which targets the neighbor's transmitter node with maximum SNR. We perform Graphical User Interface (GUI) of MATLAB for an Adaptive Array Antenna Model to show the convergence of beam with their SNR for each scheme. We also compare the impulse response of MVDR vs. MPDR and the result shows that MVDR beamformer has higher impulse response than MPDR beamformer.

articleTitle: Diurnal variations of tropopause over Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: An intensive radiosonde observation was conducted on Jan 11 to 15, in 2006 over Wuhan, from which the diurnal and daily variation of local tropopause are studied. An obviously diurnal variation of tropopause is found and more influence from stratosphere can be inferred. A stable trend of daily variation of both altitude and temperature of tropopause can be clearly observed, too.

articleTitle: The teaching reform of probability and statistics and cultivation of innovative ability
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The paper has put forward an idea about the teaching reformation to course of probability and statistics in agriculture and forestry universities. We have paid attention to the theory contact with practice. We also present a new teaching method that the idea of mathematical modeling is applied in the teaching process of application cases to reform teaching methods and seek new teaching modes. Students' ability on applying and innovation will be trained by strengthening the practice of students.

articleTitle: A study of the partner selection and evaluation for aviation subcontract production based on fuzzy AHP and TFN approach
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to improve the ability to solve partner selection and evaluation problem, such as increasing alternatives, increasing info fuzziness, and unconsidering the characteristic of the total task and the idiographic sub-task of each partner in the process on evaluating target system and decision-making approach of partner selection and evaluation for aviation subcontract production (SP), as well as to solve the inconsistence of differ judgment matrix set up in similar multi-alternative evaluation problems caused by AHP or other fuzzy AHP approaches. An evaluating targets system and multiple objects decision-making model in partner selection were put forward. An extended fuzzy AHP model based on the combination of the fuzzy AHP and the trigonometrical fuzzy number (TFN) was proposed, and an illustrative example to select the SP partner demonstrated application and examined its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Path following of a piezo-driven miniature robot based on fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper studied the path following case of a PZT-driven electromagnetic miniature robot which is used as a locomotion platform in a “Desktop Micro Robots Factory”. Considering the nonlinearity of the locomotive characteristics according to the difference equation describing the position and orientation changes of the robot, a fuzzy logic controller was designed to calculate the driven voltage amplitude applied to the two piezoelectric elements to fulfill the task. To overcome the overshoot when the robot joined the path from a far starting position, an improved method, which introduced a simple coarse initial pose error adjustment before the fuzzy controller took action, was proposed, resulting in a tracking error reduction preferably.

articleTitle: Simulation studies of optimized classical direct torque fuzzy controlled drive for permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy logic based direct torque control (DTC) scheme with optimum number of input membership functions and fuzzy inference rules is presented. The proposed direct torque fuzzy control (DTFC) algorithm is based on classical DTC while the hysteresis controllers are replaced with a single Mamdani type of fuzzy controller. As a result of such a modification, considerable flux and torque ripple reduction as well as much lower current distortion is attained, while the perfect dynamic response of classical schemes is still maintained. In fact, the obtained improvements are mainly due to linguistic nature of reasoning provided by fuzzy controller which enables more appropriate voltage vectors to be chosen for the pertaining flux and torque error values. In terms of assigned input membership functions, zero voltage vectors capability is considered yet the unnecessary algorithm complexity is avoided. As far as fuzzy inference system is concerned, the proposed controller employs less fuzzy rules compared to other classical DTFCs, which also enables lower implementation cost. The performance of such a drive is evaluated in terms of both steady state and dynamic response by means of comparative simulation study.

articleTitle: Extended Kalman filter with pseudo noise compensation for very long range radar tracking
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper considers very long range tracking with phased-array radars. It could be of challenge since the severe nonlinearity involved. An extended Kalman filter with pseudo measurement noise compensation (PMNCEKF) is proposed. Simulation comparison with the existing method shows that the proposed PMNCEKF is able to give consistent estimation results with improved range filtering performance. More importantly, it can process measurements in either the range-direction-sine (r-u-v) coordinates or the spherical (r-a-e) coordinates. For very long range tracking, the errors of the first-order series expansion of the nonlinear measurements around the predicted state can be very large, especially in the range direction. The PMNCEKF was derived by taking into account these expansion errors, which makes sure the filtering consistency.

articleTitle: Practices of agile manufacturing enterprise data security and software protection
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper took into account the agile manufacturing enterprise networks data security and software protection, put forward an enterprise classified data security and software protection solution, to discuss the enterprise data storage, transmission and application software installation authorization, license and so on, proposed a time and machine code based on MD5, AES encryption algorithm dynamic secret key the encryption mechanism, to protect the enterprise data confidentiality, integrity and availability, to achieve the software installation restrictions and using restrictions.

Author Keywords: time and machine code dynamic encrypt algorithm

articleTitle: A modified visual simulation method based on LOD
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: LOD visual simulation method which can make battle-simulation visualization, is an important method for building view-scene model. In this paper, a modified visual simulation method based on LOD is proposed. The master idea is generating initial triangle grids for view-scene using LOD method, and subdividing them using iterative fractal technology. The method not only resolves visual transition problem for different detail regions, and gets more vivid 3D view-scene by means of visual rendering, but also improving the capability of view simulation system in total. Simulation result shows the improvement performance is 3.86%.the result has been important military value in battle command.

articleTitle: Research on the control synchronized with breath based on fuzzy self-adaptive PID
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Intelligent ventilation bed is a new-style mechanical ventilation equipment, whose core is the movement system of the bed's abdomen- splint.
