In order to realize the control function synchronized with breath stably, the mathematical model of abdomen -splint is set up and fuzzy self-adaptive PID controller is designed. The parameters of the controller are dynamically adjusted with error and error changing rate. So the control performance can be satisfied momentarily. Simulation results show that using fuzzy PID controller can improve the dynamic performance and enhance the anti-jamming ability through the comparison of the traditional PID controller. At the same time, experimental results demonstrate that fuzzy self-adaptive PID controller has smaller overshoot, shorter response time. Moreover, the control precision is well, and its robustness and stability are obviously better than traditional PID.

articleTitle: Vector controlled PMSM drive based on fuzzy speed controller
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To improve the dynamic performances of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drive, a novel implementation of speed controller based on adaptive fuzzy logic is presented in this paper. Using the output of the fuzzy speed controller (FC), the quadrature axis current reference value can be obtained. At the same time, the outputs of the current controller can be corrected by the disturbance voltage observer's outputs. Results of simulation are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme under the occurrence of parameter variations and external disturbance.

articleTitle: An intelligent dynamic vehicle headlamps model based on MEMS
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Car headlamp is one of the important parts of motor vehicles. To improve the driving safety at night, methods presented here: an Automotive Intelligent Headlamp System. It used MEMS methods, three-dimensional acceleration sensor and digital signal processor TMS320F2812 to be the core components. The three-axial acceleration sensors measured the motion elements of automobile's movements. The data collected would be strengthened, filtered, A/D transformed and then processed by the core processor. Then the vehicle steering angle and pitch angle were obtained. The system workes well in controlling headlight angle. Also when the car is uphill or downhill, it can adjust the headlamps according to the value of the appropriate vertical angle. The advantages of such a kind of car headlamps are: quick response, high intelligent and good reliability.

articleTitle: Clutter characteristics analysis of airborne MIMO radar under the degradation of transmit waveforms orthogonality
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper addresses the issues of clutter characteristics of airborne MIMO radar in presence of degradation of transmit waveforms orthogonality. Firstly, synthesis subarray space and synthesis transmit signal space caused by the degradation are illustrated. Clutter model of airborne MIMO radar is developed under the orthogonal degradation. Clutter models with arbitrary waveform are unified in this model via the transform of array space and signal space. Secondly, an estimation rule for the number of clutter DOFs is presented based on band-limited signal theory. It shows that clutter DOFs is dependent on both the number of inner elements in synthetic subarray and synthetic signal. Finally, clutter characteristics under the influence of degradation are analyzed compared with the ideal MIMO radar model and phase array radar, and the effectivity of the estimation rule is verified in the numerical examination.

Author Keywords: degradation of the transmit waveform orthogonality

articleTitle: Design and analysis of power system of micro-electromechanical actuator
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to apply the electromechanical actuator to tactical mini-missiles, this paper researches on the key technology such as load-bearing ability, rapidity and miniaturization of the micro-electromechanical actuator power system based on the ball screw. First, according to specific technical indexes, the power, electromechanical time constant and the size of the motors are screened originally through theoretical analysis. Finally, based on the characteristics of ball screw transmission, load locus of the micro-electromechanical actuator dynamic system is theoretically analyzed and the optimum speed ratio is determined through parameter optimization. The results of the double closed loop controlled test on the principle prototype show: the system can operate normally with 2.5N·m hinge moment; the system bandwidth can reach 25.3Hz on the condition of no load and 23.4Hz on the condition of load; maximum rotational speed of output shafts is greater than 250°/s. Test results basically correspond to the requirement of technical indexes. It is proved that this analysis and design method is congruent with the design of micro-electromechanical actuators, thus the method is feasible.

articleTitle: Research and development of the mobile library based on WAP technology
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With the development of information technology, the traditional library service model has been difficult to satisfy user needs. In recent years, the rapid development of mobile devices provides a good platform for the expansion of library services. Therefore, using WAP Web technology to design and implement a function of more sophisticated mobile library system become possible. The mobile libraries based on WAP technology will realize the dynamic release of mobile information, mobile information queries, mobile renewals and reservations, mobile virtual reference service, electronic resources uploading and downloading and search permissions to access electronic literature databases, etc.. These functions will expand the scope of library services to enhance the full use of library resources.

articleTitle: Identification method of forest fire based on color space
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Forest fire is a kind of natural disasters with huge effect on the ecological environment of the earth. Flame color and brightness are two inherent features of the flame itself which are important static identifiable information. In order to identify the flame effectively and fight the forest fire in time the flame region may be identified based on these features in the RGB color space and HSV color space. The strengths and weaknesses of extracting the flame region with these two different color spaces are compared. At the same time because the value range of parameter H is discontinuous when converting the RGB color space to the HSV color space, the conversion formula is modified. Many experiments and tests indicate that this method is verified to be effective.

articleTitle: Study on propagation model tuning based on TD-SCDMA System
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper provides a fast and precise tuning method based on linear least-square theory to tune the standard general macro cell propagation model. This method depends on existed tuning methods and the CW (Continuous Wave) testing data of a certain city. Furthermore, using this method can obtain actual outdoor propagation model fitting for TD-SCDMA network. Simulation results indicate that the calculating complexity is reduced obviously, and the maximum error of forecasting data calculated by tuned model reduces by 20.7%, and the tuned model matches the local ratio propagation environment much better.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: A novel parallel motif discovery algorithm based on de Bruijn graph
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper attempts to provide a new approach to discover conserved regions such as motifs in either DNA or Protein sequences. We not only use the idea of de Bruijn graphs, but also follow a parallel approach to solve this problem. The de Bruijn graph has been successfully adopted to solve problems such as local alignment and DNA fragment assembly. To accelerate the speed, our method harnesses the power of parallelism to discover the conserved regions in a DNA or protein sequence. We have found that the algorithm was successful in mining signals for larger number of sequences and at a faster rate when compared to some popular motif searching tools.

articleTitle: Reliable indoor location sensing technique using active RFID
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper aims to locate multiple tags in the indoor environment by using low cost devices, active Radio Frequency Identification (RFID). A more reliable positioning algorithm using Mahalanobis distance based on Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI) is proposed to improve location accuracy, since in this method covariance is taken into account to avoid unnecessary mistakes. Reference tags and readers with known location, which is proposed in LANDMARC system, are used to estimate target tag location. The results from conducting extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can achieve more reliable and higher performance than LANDMARC algorithm without using any additional optimal methods.

articleTitle: Application of support vector regression trained by particle swarm optimization in warrant price prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Warrant price prediction is very important to investment. Support vector regression technique is a learning procedure based on statistical learning theory, which employs the training data to build an excellent forecasting model in the situations of small sample. The prediction ability of support vector regression is influenced by its training parameters. Particle swarm optimization is applied to choose the parameters of support vector regression. Then, support vector machine trained by particle swarm optimization is presented to predict warrant price. The prediction ability of warrant price of the method is studied by the historical warrant price data including seven data points of a certain warrant. It can be seen that the warrant price prediction performance of PSO-SVR is better than that of BPNN by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Adaptive neural network tracking control of robot manipulators including motor dynamics: Dynamic surface backstepping methodology
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: To solve the trajectory tracking control problem for rigid-link robot manipulators including actuator dynamics, a novel neural network (NN)-based adaptive algorithm is discussed. In the proposed control algorithm, radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) is adopted to approximate the nonlinear dynamics of the robot manipulators' electromechanical system. Moreover, the key features are that, firstly, the unmatched & uncertainties of the system are overcame, secondly, the problem of “explosion of complexity” inherent in the conventional backstepping method is avoided due to combing with “dynamic surface control” (DSC) approach. Finally, simulation results are included to demonstrate the tracking performance and the effectiveness of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Computer-aided cam design of high-speed under-table swing-arm gripper system in sheet-fed offset press
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: By analyzing various kinds of gripper systems of different sheet-fed offset presses, the under-table swing-arm system, with a fixed axis, has the advantages of meeting high-speed press running requirement, keeping longer dwell time of printing sheets, helping improve print registration, and hence in favor of assuring HIFI print quality while having high press output. The CAD conjugate cams, which control the double swing-arm 4-bar linkage, determine the swing motion of high-speed gripper system. The formulas of gripper-swing-arm's motion needed for the conjugate cams' CAD are derived in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimal PID controller design in PMSM based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A novel PID controller design method based on Improved Genetic Algorithm is proposed in the paper for PMSM Servo system. By using real-coded chromosomes scheme, and strategies of protecting the best individual, accepting immigrations, as well as employing adaptive crossover and mutation operators, meanwhile, choose output-overshoot, rise time and steady error of the system as the fitness function to weight the system performance. The global searching ability and the convergence speed of the IGA are significantly improved, and the performance of the PID controller is optimized to satisfaction. Experiment results show that the novel PID controller design method can achieve a faster Motor response, better traceability and markedly improved control results.

articleTitle: The study on key distribution and management mechanisms in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is constructed by a group of sensor nodes with characteristics of tiny shape, low-energy consumption and cheap cost. In general, sensor nodes are distributed in a certain area. In this paper, we find the root of a finite field polynomial to achieve the implicit security. We partition the key and distribute to the nodes of network. We can use these key partitions to revert to the original key.

articleTitle: A remote sensing images feature selection approach based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Some initial investigations are conducted to apply Ant Colony Algorithm (ACO) for feature selection of remote sensing images. As a novel branch of computational intelligence, ACO has strong capabilities of Self-organization adaptation; hence it is natural to view ACO as a powerful information processing and problem-solving method in both the scientific and engineering fields. Ant Colony Algorithm posses nonlinear classification properties along with the biological properties, being parallel operation and insensitiveness to initial condition of images. Preliminary Results indicate effectiveness and application of our method proposed and efficiently avoid some drawbacks of traditional methods. In addition our work also pushes research on this problem further.

articleTitle: Research for parameter selection scheduling system oriented to two grades of users
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The scheme is proposed for parameter selection scheduling system oriented to two grades of users based on the analysis for machining parameters selection and operation scheduling. First, the architecture is described and the function of each component is expatiated; Second, working principle and operating mode of the whole system is analyzed to systematize the problem of selecting the machining parameters during the scheduling course. The performance of system is favorable by application example test.

articleTitle: Efficiently utilization of redundancy backup server by forming dynamic clustering in Distributed Systems for tolerating faults
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper proposes a novel REDENDENCY THROUGH BACKUP PROCESS with CLUSTERING scheme which aims to address the following concerns: reliable, effective with high maintenance backup can be achieved by constructing a multi-node clustering backbone with a small number of backup cluster-heads for redundancy filling system through backup process for FAULT TOLRANCE DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS. We can successfully reduce the overhead of backup servers and enhance the speed of backup delivering in an allowable time span compared to other redundancy fault tolerance distributed operating systems for both WAN and LAN networks. Next, we utilize the CLUSTER STRUCHING MECHANISM which determines the cluster size according to the leaving frequency of cluster-members. As the number of leaving events is reduced, the cluster topology is more stable and the BACKUP may also be available in a short and manageable time span before all the distributed system becomes failed. We have done our simulation using MATLAB to show cluster formation with a back-up server election and have investigated the performance of our system for different scenarios.

articleTitle: QR decomposition-based LS channel estimation algorithm in MIMO-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: It discusses the channel estimation algorithm of LS. Because of the complexity of the matrix inversion computation in LS algorithm, we use QR decomposition in LS, that is QRD-LS. Then, the complexity of LS algorithm can be reduced. From the simulation of the LS and QRD-LS algorithm. We can see that the performance of these two algorithm is similary. However, the QRD-LS algorithm has no matrix inversion. So, this algorithm can simplify the calculation.

articleTitle: The study on the soliton control for the nonlinear (2+1)-dimensional Sasa-Satsuma system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The exact soliton solutions are constructed by extending the (G'/G)-expansion method for the nonlinear (2+1)-dimensional Sasa-Satsuma system. The soliton controls are studied. The soliton can vary in shapes and amplitudes under the control of the parameters in the soliton solutions for the system.

articleTitle: Stochastic characteristic analysis of turbine rotor based on response surface method
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of turbine rotor design, response surface method is introduced into probability finite element, and geometrical parameters, material parameters and load parameters of rotor are considered as input random variables, through calculating and then obtaining the statistical characteristics and cumulative distribution function of stochastic response of the rotor. Then, probability sensitivities analysis is applied to evaluate how much the output parameters are influenced by the random input parameters. In the last, through analyzing Scatter plots of structural responses with respect to the random input variables, advancing how to improve the reliability of rotor. The results show that using this method leads to fast speed, much less amount of calculation and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control for a class of matched uncertain hybrid linear systems with Markovian jump parameter
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The problem of sliding mode control for a class of uncertain hybrid linear systems with matched Markovian jump parameter is considered. Under the assumptions of matched known upper bound system uncertainties and unknown upper bound system uncertainties, the sufficient conditions are proposed to guarantee the mean exponentially stability of reduced-order sliding mode system. Under the assumption of two kinds of system uncertainties, conventional sliding mode control law and adaptive sliding mode control law are proposed. The control methods guarantee that the trajectory of system arrives at the sliding surface in finite time interval and is kept here thereafter. Finally, a simulation is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The research of a new architecture in expert system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: For the traditional expert system problems, combined with service-oriented architecture (SOA) and soft-bus idea, proposed a expert system design under a new architecture. And taking the medical expert system for example, clarify the advantages of the design, which has great significance for achieving the integration of expert system, interface standardization and system scalability.

articleTitle: Design of measurement and control system for sling stretch test machine based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Based on the principle of virtual instrument, a measurement and control system for sling stretch test machine was constructed via the software platform of LabVIEW. Detail the hardware components, work processes and software design method of the system, giving the main block diagram program. The system is capable of monitoring the process of sling stretch test, with digital display, graphics display, data storage and playback functions. It has been proved that the system has the advantage of friendly interface, high reliability and short development cycle, etc., to meet test requirements in practical application.

articleTitle: Algorithm on analyzing RLC electrical network independent all-inductor loop
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In paper [8], author has proved that the characteristic roots of A are zeros or unequal non-constants. It is well-known that the independent all-capacitor cut-set and the all-inductor loop would lead the electrical network to have zero eigenvalues. But, how to find out the number of the “independent” all-capacitor cut-sets and the all-inductor loops in a network, obviously if the network is complex, is a hard work. It cannot be done artificially. If we use computer to do it, we need a good algorithm. The paper would give an algorithm on how to find them. and it will help us to research these special structures affect the controllability and observability of electrical network. Both are the reasons why we study this algorithm. In this paper, author expatiates on it and uses an example to show the process in detail.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation of E-commerce website based on set pair analysis and VIKOR algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: As a bridge of communication between enterprise and customers, E-commerce website has important influence for selection of customers. Whether E-Commerce Website is accurately evaluated is essential a very key issue. Objective and reasonable evaluation can make the E-commerce website perfection, and through evaluated result, the shortcomings of E-commerce website can be corrected. This paper presents a methodology combined set pair analysis and VIKOR algorithm, the proposed method combines the certainty and uncertainty analysis, involves less computation and allows an easier application.

articleTitle: A Differential Evolution algorithm based on Ordering of individuals
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Differential Evolution (DE) algorithm has been shown to be powerful for many real optimization problems. To improve the robustness and convergence speed, we propose a novel method, which is ordering of individuals in the population. This has changed the structure of population in traditional DE algorithm, which is always randomly generated and randomly evolved. Ordering of individuals improved the stability of the evolved solution immensely. Differential Evolution algorithm based on Ordering of individuals (ODE) is the basic pattern of the applications of ordering and combined with other means, ordering would get a better performance to strengthen the robustness of DE algorithm. By the experimental testing of benchmark functions, the results show ODE algorithm has a better performance than DE algorithm especially in robustness.

articleTitle: New delay-dependent robust stability condition for neutral-type neural networks with mixed time delays
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The robust exponential stability is investigated for a class of uncertain neutral-type neural networks with both variable and distributed time-varying delays. By introducing a new vector Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional, using Jensen integral inequality and linear matrix inequality(LMI) techniques, two delay-dependent sufficient criteria are obtained for exponential stability of considered neural networks, which generalize some previous results in the literature. Three examples are given to show the less conservativeness of the obtained conditions.

articleTitle: The research of zero torsional stiffness rotating gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A kind of gyroscope which used to detect yaw angular velocity of the rotating carrier is designed and produced in the “zero torsional stiffness” condition. To analysis the gyroscope's working principle and establishing the mathematic model of the gyroscope, then designing and producing the gyroscope's sensitive structure of zero-torsion stiffness. Using alternating current bridge, the changing capacitance can be achieved, thus the rotating body yaw rate can be measured. In the case of different spin angular velocity of revolving solid, the gyro's output signal is measured, and the scaling factor is: When φ = 10Hz, scaling factor K = 20.96(mV/°/s); When φ = 12Hz, scaling factor K = 21.12(mV/°/s); When φ = 14Hz, scaling factor K = 21.10(mV/°/s). Theoretical research and performance test indicated that in condition of zero torsional stiffness of gyro vibration element, the gyro's output signal only have relation with angular O, not with the revolving solid's rotation rate φ.

articleTitle: Face recognition based on MPCA
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, A new method of face recognition based on multilinear principal component analysis (MPCA) is proposed. First, instead of transforming matrices into vectors for principal component analysis (PCA), the MPCA can use matrices or higher-order tensors directly to capture most variance for dimensionality reduction. The total scatter can be maximized by optimizing the projection matrix. Then all entries from the resulted matrix are sorted according to their class discrimination power for feature selection. Last, the nearest neighbor classifier is used to recognize different faces from the ORL face database. The best accuracy rate can reach 97%.

articleTitle: Linear combination design of Gaussian pulses for UWB vehicular radar system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A linear combination design of Gaussian pulses for UWB vehicular radar system is presented. By adjusting the parameters such as the variance and the value of the amplitude spectral, the corresponding PSD of linear combination pulse is obtained which must match the FCC's PSD mask as closely as possible and maximize the bandwidth. Then, combination coefficient is calculated by the solution of algebraic equation group with PSD restraint conditions. Simulation results show that the method has higher spectral utilization ratio.

articleTitle: Security model research and design based on separate storage of keys
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Important data are usually encrypted and stored separately with key. It requires high security. A security model, which is based on security need of data and analysis on design points of excellent encryption software, was proposed for encryption software. This model considers users, encryption platform, key device, and encrypted data as a whole, establishes mutual security relations of the four elements, constructs systemic security relations for the process of encryption, solves security problem of separately stored key.

articleTitle: Adaptive fuzzy control for wireless network
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Compared with wired networks, the application of TCP over wireless networks is much different due to high bit error rates, fading and handoff. A new approach is proposed that improved transport control protocol (TCP) throughput in wireless networks, in which a fuzzy adaptive control algorithm based on BS buffer changing is adopted to calculate the congest window, and explicit feedback to TCP sender. As a result, the TCP sending window can respond to the load changes of networks rapidly, the loss of packets is avoided and the TCP flow becomes smoother. The simulation results show that this method can strengthen the adaptation and channel errors processing capability in real time and improve the throughput of the network, and this control scheme is more robust and adaptive than normal Snoop.

articleTitle: The research of the Dynamic and Reflective Scheduling and dispatching service with Adaptive Characteristics in DRE system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Distributed real-time embedded (DRE) systems are becoming increasingly widespread and important. One of the difficulties is how to schedule and dispatch real-time tasks correctly and efficiently at run-time, such as ready queue maintaining, thread model and periodic control. It is extremely necessary to abstract the commonness from DRE systems, after carefully design and optimization, and then implement it as scheduling and dispatching service in the middleware level. This paper proposes a Reflective and Dynamic Scheduling and Dispatching Service with Adaptive Characteristics (RDSDSAC). It will achieve the objectives mentioned above with the RDSDSAC. The RDSDSAC consists of a basic scheduler and a elastic scheduler, with the help of these two schedulers, RDSDSAC shields DRE developers from worrying about how the real-time tasks are performed, what need to be implemented by the developers is simply the business logic and scheduling parameters.

Author Keywords: dynamic and reflective scheduling and dispatching service

articleTitle: The research and implementation of the mathematics experimental courses of mathematics teaching in Normal College
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In 21st Century, it raised new demands in mathematics teaching in colleges and universities, while mathematical experiment courses playing an increasingly important role. In this paper, it explained the necessity and significance of offering mathematical experiment courses in the Normal Colleges and universities pointed out the current situation and implementation of it, and provided clues for the reform of mathematics teaching in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: LMI-based robust controller and filter design for a line-of-sight stabilization system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper was concerned with robust controller and filter design via LMI(Linear Matrix Inequality) for a line-of-sight(LOS) stabilization system and its performance test. Firstly the LMI-based robust controller and filter design methods were proposed. Then the filters for piezoelectric gyroscope drift in LOS were designed and compared through simulation. Further the uncertainties of the LOS were discussed. Facing these real uncertainties the LMI-based robust controllers were designed and simulated compared with the conventional controller. Finally the realization of the LOS system based on Digital Signal Controller (DSC) and its performance test had been briefly described. The proposed study provided an effective analysis and design method for the LOS to improve its disturbance rejection and robust performance.

articleTitle: Research on the state observer of the vehicle body slip angle based on the Recursive Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The estimation of the body slip angle is the key problem in the electronic stability control system design. In this paper a state observer of the vehicle body slip angle is designed by considering the variation of the vehicle model parameters timely, which are effected by the maneuvers. In order to get a better state estimation value, the tire cornering stiffness is identified online based on the Recursive Least Squares (RLS). According to the results of simulation, the state observer with sufficient robustness can be used to overcome the impact of model error and the effectiveness of the observer can be verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Design of a robust vehicle dynamics controller based on optimal fuzzy theory for passenger car
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: A novel algorithm for Vehicle Dynamics Control is developed for tracking desired vehicle behavior. This algorithm employs the optimal and fuzzy control theory to enhance stability and improve performance. The optimal theory is exploited for yaw moment controller and the fuzzy theory is applied for wheel slip controller design. The performance of the proposed controller strategy is evaluated under various emergency maneuvers and road conditions. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the control algorithm developed.

articleTitle: Dividing target-coverage graph in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to reduce the algorithm complexity of the target coverage problem which is a NP-complete problem, we design three approaches to shorten the network scale. We firstly delete redundant sensor nodes, secondly remove the redundant targets, and thirdly divide the target-coverage graph into independent sub-graphs, and present the construct independent sub graph algorithm (CISGA) to divide target-coverage graph. Measurement results show that CISGA could reduce 30% of network scale and greatly reduce the algorithm complexity of target coverage problem.

articleTitle: Internal model control based on RBF neural network an application for fermentation process of beer
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Aiming at a nonlinear, time variant and time delay temperature control system in beer fermentation process, this paper presents an algorithm using internal model control based on RBF neural network. The internal model and the controller are represented by Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network respectively. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has good properties in terms of robustness and transient.

articleTitle: Emergency management simulation of public accident based on evolutionary game
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Based on the theory of Complexity Adaptive System, we attempt to study the emergency management system of public accident through evolutionary game theory and simulate the evolutionary game. Evolutionary game theory is based on boundedly-rationality, takes the community as the research object, and it provides the decision-making basis to the emergency management system of public accident.

articleTitle: Some MIMO radar advantages over phased array radar
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: MIMO radar is a new radar technique developed recently. It can achieve better detection performance than conventional phased radar. In this paper, we investigate some advantages of MIMO radar on the non-ideal factor of transmitting signal such as the instability in signal phase and the spur in transmitting signal etc. And then, a simulation system was established, some simulation shows the advantage of MIMO radar over its conventional counterpart.

articleTitle: Research on hybrid communication technology of highway overload monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Overloading is a violation, which is needed to monitor mainly. Monitoring vehicle information accurately and timely is a necessary information mean, which is used to ensure highway safety. Aiming at the actual demand, this paper proposes a hybrid communication technology scheme of vehicle overload monitoring system, which is based on the combination of power line carrier communication and Zigbee wireless communication. Design scheme of this system has some reference value for monitoring system communication research of similar domain.

articleTitle: A fuzzy inference framework for detecting intrusions in urban transit
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: It is very important to prevent crimes, accidents, and incidents, so many surveillance systems are equipped in urban transit system. But in most current surveillance systems, supervisors have to monitor many screens continuously. Therefore, intelligent systems are needed by which those tedious monitoring tasks are done. These intelligent surveillance systems have two parts: image processing, context inference module. Because there are many uncertain events in urban transit, fuzzy inference engine is needed that efficiently handle these events and solve the problems that can occur in the dangerous situation. In this paper, we present a fuzzy framework that can efficiently detect dangerous situations in urban transit and classify the contexts according to their dangerous situation.

articleTitle: A study on a new drafting transmission system of rubbed roving frame
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Rubbed roving frames are main textile machines, and the drafting transmission system is the key one which constitutes rubbed roving frame, whose studies have absorbed some people at home and abroad who are in this field. A new type of rubbed roving frame drafting transmission system is presented in this paper, which consists of the main drawing part and the fine-tuning parts of drawing tension. The main drawing part is mostly composed of a pair of pulley speed change mechanism which can meet the range requirements of drawing multiple. The fine-tuning parts of drawing tension consist of nine-link corrected gear and slipping gear. Tension adjustment range and the difference in the rate of transformation can be met through the gearing mesh of the same diameter and different modification coefficient. Drawing multiple design method of these two forms of coupling drawing is proposed, and nine-link corrected gear coefficient theory formulas and slipping gear design formulas are derived. Twin-wheel design method is given based on series portfolio theory. The problem that the same drawing system can meet different fiber drawing effects having differences is solved. As a result, a new design method of drafting transmission system of rubbed roving frame is established.

articleTitle: The application of compound control in digital SVPWM inverter based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The control strategy is the main fact to determines output wave quality of the sine wave inverter, Both the PID control of the traditional and modern control theory are difficult to realize good control effects to inverter. This paper brings forward a kind of control strategy adopting active disturbance rejection control and PID control through the analysis of different control methods. Meanwhile, MS320F28335 DSP was adopted as the main control core. Not only simulating system through MATLAB2007B, demonstrating the trials ashibit the inverter circuit of hardware. Simulation and trial results show this design can realize the high precision steady output, it has a simple arithmetic, well dynamic response performance and the wonderful application prospect.

articleTitle: Research and practice for teaching methods of college mathematics with the aim of engineering application in independent colleges
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: As an important basic course for science and engineering students, it plays an irreplaceable role to cultivate and improve the comprehensive qualities and abilities of students. In this paper, engineering applications-oriented, firstly it analyzes that the current situation and problems which exist in math series curricula in the independent colleges, and then proceed new teaching method. The method is from reality. It combines many teaching method and mainly is based classroom teaching. It focuses on the coordination of effect of mathematics history and the relevant curricula and the method also uses multimedia technology and mathematics software. Then from the contrast of the results of the Mathematical Contest in Modeling, it shows the method has the scientific efficiency, and the research promotes the teaching reform of college Mathematics in independent colleges.

articleTitle: Safety analysis of complex systems based on Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for safety analysis of complex systems. The Bayeisan Networks has been modeled based on failure scenarios contained a large number information of Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis accumulated in the production and use stages of complex systems. The model's constrution, probabilistic inference, sensetivity annlysis is analysised through a case study on controllable-pitch propeller and shafting system. The results show the validity and convenience of the method and great advantages and applications prospects of Bayesian Networks in safety analysis of complex systems.

articleTitle: Car dumper strain signal analysis based on the histogram processing of HS
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: As the strain signals of the metal structure is nonlinear, non-stationary and complexity, inevitable, the Hilbert Spectrum(HS) obtained by the classical HHT (Hilbert-Huang Transform) method is often disrupted by noise and performs poor time-frequency concentration which will certainly affect the readability of time-frequency spectrum. This paper aims to extract signal feature from noise background without destruction of the internal characteristics of the signal. A novel HS analysis approach based on histogram processing is proposed. The approach ignores the value of the smaller frequency points, retains larger points of the frequency values. The experiments results showed that the feature of car dumper strain signals was extracted more effectively by using histogram processing compared with the classical HHT methods.

articleTitle: An analysis of audio encoding rate selection by MOS based complexity
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Currently audio encoding rate selection is mostly based on the extent of the channel congestion. This paper presents an analysis of complexity of audio based on Mean Opinion Score (MOS). A primitive encoding rate selection system is also set up for evaluation. The different styles of music exhibit various requirement of encoding rates in the view of MOS. Experiment results indicate that the proposed system gives good estimation of encoding rate given the music style.

articleTitle: A web-based approach of remote cooperative production scheduling and control in distributed network manufacturing for subcontract production
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Aviation subcontract production (SP), the particular manufacturing mode of aeronautical manufacturing enterprise (AME), is an important approach and instrumentality participated in international market competition. In this paper, a Web-based approach of remote cooperative production scheduling and control (CPSC) in distributed network manufacturing for subcontract production is proposed, and an implement framework on remote CPSC over Internet is accomplished. As a result, this study on the remote CPSC over Internet in distributed network manufacturing for SP is important for advancing the technical ability of aviation manufacturing, enhancing the manufacturing strength, and promoting the management level of the aeronautical SP, and a prospective and specific sample model with manufactures in decentralized network and integrated product development and manufacturing.

articleTitle: Correlation-enhanced adaptive Internal Model Control
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Internal Model Control is a popular industrial control method, which can be made adaptive through the introduction of adaptive filters. In this paper, we describe a method for augmenting such control structures in order to control plants with unspecified sensors, and subject to unspecific, time-varying noise. Our technique is based on adding correlators to adaptive filters. This technique is also applicable to MIMO systems. Potential applications include control systems equipped with distributed sensors and systems subject to time-varying wide-band noise. Computations are simple and suitable for parallel execution.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis and optimal design of the mudsill and bracket of large-scale bag filter
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: By using the finite element analysis software ANSYS, the model of the mudsill and bracket of large-scale bag filter was established, and the stress distribution and deformation of the structure were analyzed. Then under the prerequisite of the mudsill and bracket structure satisfied in possessing enough strength and stiffness and taking the mass of the structure to be the lightest as the target, the optimal design of structural parameters was carried out. This provides important theoretical basis and technical support for the production of the mudsill and bracket structure.

articleTitle: The research on CAD/CAPP/CAM concurrent engineering of Panel furniture Agile Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Describes Panel furniture's enterprise of Agile Manufacturing System application, discusses transformation from traditional furniture enterprise become to agile manufacturing enterprise, and orders-oriented quickly design and production management's technical elements, including product classification model, parameter-driven and model-driven model, intelligent calculation, Object-oriented Unified BOM Model, CAD/CAPP/CAM concurrent engineering, twodimensional dynamic time scheduling, and so on. the author realized a man-machine cooperation's customized Panel furniture Agile Manufacturing System, using the CAD subsystem, design furniture, output panel lists, using CAPP subsystem to generate optimum panel cutting data, be optimized tool path, automatically converted into CNC code, and directly sent to CNC machining equipment, to improve design and production's speeds, to improve production management level, completed agile manufacturing target, achieved remarkable results.

articleTitle: Algorithm of baking tobacco control decision system based on Fuzzy Control and Lagrange Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The paper aimed at a new method based on Fuzzy Control and Lagrange Interpolation, to control and make decision of tobacco baking temperature. In the method, we calculated dry temperature and humidity the next scale time with Lagrange Interpolation through the dry temperature and humidity in the tobacco oven through the temperature of the sensors before the time, then control the degree of ventilation door next step under the guidance of the Fuzzy Control. Compared to the traditional simple Fuzzy Control method and Fuzzy-PID method, the results show that the new algorithm can control the temperature better to ensure the quality of the tobacco quality.

articleTitle: The design and practice of numerical analysis teaching platform
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Numerical analysis is an important basis of science and engineering professional courses in higher education system. The course not only can train the thinking ability in mathematics, but also be able to train students to apply scientific methodology and computer technology to analyze and solve practical problems. Based on the teaching practice in the past decade, we have made the multi-level researches and reform on the teaching mode, teaching content, teaching methods and so on. The multi-dimensional teaching platform which can effectively support series of numerical analysis courses gradually formed. This article focuses on introducing the multi-dimensional design and teaching practice of the platform.

articleTitle: Considerations for optical sensor design
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In the last decade, China experienced rapid development of spaceborne high resolution optical sensor. A good example is CBERS-02B satellite launched in 2007, whose spatial resolution is 2.36m and satisfies requirement from many fields. However, several problems need to be solved for further improvement in spatial resolution. With the same detector number, higher spatial resolution leads to unfavorable narrower swath..And adopting agile imaging will derives more geometric distortions. Cost control prefers a small and light sensor with small diameter of mirror, which leads to low irradiance on the focal plane. Such radiometric and geometric problems could be solved in data processing scheme. Therefore, data processing scheme should be paid more attention in optical sensor design. Since the design of optical sensor is systematic and complicated, in this paper, only selected issues were considered and analyzed to put up with demands for the support from technique development.

articleTitle: Development of Library Subject Service System in the network environment
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: With the promotion of subject service, subject librarians have an urgent need to draw a network platform to conduct virtual management. This article describes “Subject Service System” developed by the library of Shenyang Normal University, and describes the development process of the system from four aspects: system design, structure function, effects of system applications, and evaluation of system application.

articleTitle: PID control in adjustable-pitch wind turbine system based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: PID controller is widely used in different kinds of industry circumstance. Because of the difficulty for modeling the industry plants and the frequent change of the parameters of plants, it often could not be gotten optimal control effects by using common PID controllers. So it is significant to find the tuning methods which are simple, practical and have good performance. A fuzzy tuning algorithm is gives and the algorithm simulated by Matlab. The results show that the method is practical and effective.

articleTitle: Research on relationship between drainage modulus and drainage area in large urbanized polder
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Large urbanized polders, are always with developed economy and concentrated population, in which the lacking river storage capacity makes the risk of flood and waterlog increase. Therefore, it's much more necessary to study more accurate method of drainage calculation and the relationship between the drainage modulus and the drainage area for the drainage strategy in urbanized polder. According to the analysis of the characteristics of urban drainage, Unsteady Flow Equations was used to calculate in details. In the process, the node with drainage pump stations was treated as the virtual outer river in order to suit the characteristics of pump draining. With the drainage area changing, relationship between the drainage modulus and the area was gained, which can provide the basis for choosing appropriate drainage strategy.

articleTitle: Singular kinetics analysis of universal Cartesian serial-parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: New type of universal Cartesian serial-parallel manipulator in singular configuration, kinetics equations and Euler's equations constructed, complete analysis of each jointed points of the moving platform carried out, inverse kinetics solution can be obtained with the given parameters, which include the position and orientation of the manipulator, applied force on the output shaft, parameters of motion of output shaft and connecting bar and sliding block, Newton-Euler method adopted to analysis its kinetics,program used to get the intuitionistic graph result of analysis, conclusion deduced from the result, difference exist in the changing rule of force of joints on upper layer platform and under layer platform, the changing rule of force of joints on the same platform is the same, sensitive exist in direction of axis x,y,z of force of joints on under layer platform, while sensitive exist in direction of axis z of force of joints on upper layer platform only.

articleTitle: The study on verification of distributed algorithm for ring databases
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In this paper, we have applied a simple set theory for validating a simplified version of the algorithm. Even though Rescoes algorithm is dramatically simplified so that some inner characteristics of the algorithm are accidentally removed, the mathematical structure we have developed is already relatively complicated. Our abstraction could make some useful insights into this so complicated problem that is the data replication consistency over a distributed database.

articleTitle: Research on improved power exponent function for life prediction method
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: On the base of researching on Manson-coffin function, walker strain life prediction model, the method based on the three parameter power formulation and power function model for low cycle life prediction, an improved power exponent function model is proposed and a specific solving process is given. The improved method is validated in low cycle fatigue test with GH4133 material under strain ratio of −1 and 0.44 at 250°C. Through the analysis of life dispersion coefficient, standard deviation and comparing with other life prediction methods, the improved method has a higher calculation accuracy and does not require an average strain or stress amendment. Fatigue test data with different strain ratio are fit together at the same time.

articleTitle: E-business website evaluating base on extension theory
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Website evaluation is affected by multiple factors, that is important for E-business system evaluation. The principles of extension theory have been used in this paper to establish the matter-element model for the evaluation of website. The quantitative evaluated results have been given through the calculation of the matter-element dependent degree. A case analysis has indicated that by using extension theory, the evaluation index of the multiple factors on website evaluating is effective and feasible. The conclusions obtained are basically consistent with the engineering practice and have the significance of reference for solving similar problems in website evaluation.

articleTitle: The discussion of starting experimental courses in the teaching of linear algrbra
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Linear algebra is an important fundamental course to each profession students in engineering colleges, having special features which are different from other courses in improving the quality of students. By analyzing the drawbacks of teaching linear algebra traditionally, combining with the new situations and new problems today's higher education faced, contacting with many years' self teaching experience, this paper made clear, in the course of teaching, the necessity and feasibility of the introduction of experimental courses, and put forward a reasonable implementing scheme to open experimental course of linear algebra. Furthermore, experimental teaching stimulated students' learning interest, and enhanced the students' capacity of analyzing and solving practical problems using the knowledge of linear algebra, which would be beneficial to the cultivation of technology innovation talents of today's students.

articleTitle: Exploring the garment fashionable shape oriented manufacture database
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Based on the research about outside shape of woman warm jacket more than twenty years, fashion variables that were representative and can describe the fashionable shape were discussed. Experiment was designed to achieve data of large numbers of female body. Body size variables were statistically analyzed to decide the module that was the basement for achieving data from historical photos. Fashionable characteristic diagrams of garment length, front chest width, shoulder length, collar height and their error bar charts were drawn for discussing the change of fashionable shape. The fashion trends in the future were also prognosticated scientifically. At the same time, a historical database was developed for manufacture and designing, which it is the basement for automatic pattern designing. This new method for fashion trend research was introduced by data mining technology, which it opens our minds for garment science research and offers a new database for improving garment CAD system..

articleTitle: Electrical leak location method for double-lined landfills
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The electrical landfill leakage detection method detects and locates leaks in geomembrane liners by measuring the potential distribution above or under the liner. For double-lined landfills, the detecting electrodes are usually arranged between the two liners (detection layer). A detection model for double-lined landfills was set up in this paper. The current flowing through the leak and the returned current in the power supply electrode in the detection layer were regarded as two current point sources with opposite polarity. The total potential was obtained by the superposition of potentials produced by the two current point sources. the analysis of potential equation show that: (1) the potential distribution is almost independent of the position of survey lines; (2) when the detection layer is thinner, the potential increases obviously for constant detecting current; (3) a slight increase of potential relative to the same reference electrode is gained when the distance of power supply electrode become farther.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation method for periodical model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Periodical problem is of common occurrence in many applied fields. In this paper the equation with periodical condition and small parameter is considered. The problem will lead to large oscillation since the parameter is small. The boundary layer function is presented firstly. The smooth component is constructed by the boundary layer function secondly. The error estimation of analytical solution is proved to be order one with respect to small parameter thirdly. Finite differential method is proposed for the smooth component. Numerical error analysis is given fourthly. Simulation example is presented to illustrate our theoretical result finally.

articleTitle: Evaluation research of enterprise CKM level based on two-tuple linguistic model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Firstly, this paper constructs a reasonable customer knowledge management(CKM) evaluation indicator system. Secondly, the author constructs the evaluation model of the CKM level based on the directly language two-tuple linguistic and relative operators. This model not only can rank the CKM level of enterprises, but also can achieve the qualitative evaluation. Finally, through demonstrating case, which shows that the evaluation method is simple to use and easy to promote.

articleTitle: The application of Hilbert_Huang transform in frequency estimation of the passive location
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to solve the shortcomings of quantitative time and frequency analysis along with the weakness of self adapting in wavelet transform, the Hilbert-Huang transform is adopted in this article to solve the fund subject of the spaceflight, the puzzle of accurate precision of the frequency in noncooperated source is solved, the matlab simulation has been carried on, the result has verified the feasibility and precision of the method in frequency measurement of sine signal along with Gauss complex circle flat noise, the noiseproof feature is also wonderful, in the condition of SNR ≥ 5dB, for all kinds of modulation signal of the location technology, the estimated accuracy is suitable for the subject.

articleTitle: The multi-objective optimization design and simulation of rocker-slider mechanism for lifting platform based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This paper introduces the way to optimize the rocker-slider mechanism for lifting platform based on genetic algorithm of excessive objects, aimed at the minimum compression height, the maximum lifting height and the largest cylinder's axial force. And combined with MATLAB's graph management and interface development function, we have produced a motion simulation for the rocker-slider mechanism for lifting platform. The optimization result indicates that this method has overcome the shortcoming of traditional ones, and it has great advantages on the process of solution and intuitional representation.

Author Keywords: the rocker-slider mechanism for lifting platform

articleTitle: Study on the delivery response time decision model of TPT-CLSC
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: Closed-loop supply chain based on third-party take back model (TPT-CLSC) is the key issue on business area. Making use of the production of supply chain response time, this paper studies TPT-CLSC decision-making mode based on delivery response time using game theory, and analyzes the optimal delivery response time and pricing strategies of decentralized decision-making and centralized decision-making which are two of TPT-CLSC model. We can draw a conclusion: the latter excel the former, at the same time, delivery response time in TPT-CLSC can not affected by decision model, which the two model's delivery response time is equal. In the end, author uses numerical analysis verifying the accuracy of above conclusions.

articleTitle: Distributed ontology integration mechanism and concept lattice redundant relations reduction algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: In order to solve the absence of semantics that causes a central difficulty of automatic selection and combination of Web services,for the form of semantic Web services and distributed ontology integration needs, the paper proposes a form of semantic-based distributed ontology integration methods, builds a platform that can be shared semantics, gives a distributed ontology integration relationship between the reduction algorithms. This method does not rely on artificial participation, a high degree of formalization to achieve the effective integration of distributed ontology. The experiments show that the method effective reduces the redundant language relations of ontology integration, improves the quality and efficiency of ontology integration.

articleTitle: Study of grain logistics Vehicle Routing Problem based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: The field of grain logistics transport vehicle route has seen the development of a variety of mathematical techniques, and the practical application of these techniques has depended on the use of spatial information, such as regional allocation information of road network. Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) is regarded as the key of grain logistics distribution. In this paper, firstly, focus on the grain logistics VRP with time windows, then VRP model is successful constructed. In order to reduce the cost of grain logistics distribution, to combine the VRP model to geographic information system (GIS) by analyzing the VRP model. GIS takes into account for grain logistics, and the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used for the identification of optimal routes. And the optimal route for grain distribution is urgent since it has been calculated that, of the total cost for transportation. It improves the efficiency of grain logistics distribution and gets a better effect.

articleTitle: A new manufacture-oriented method of pattern making
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Industrial Mechatronics and Automation
abstract: This article aimed to find a new way to transform the graphic image (drawing, photos, etc) to the pattern parameters of female apparel with raglan sleeve. The correlation and regressive analysis were used to the data in order to find the existing laws between them. The practical examinations demonstrated the good predictability of equations established.
